text: A-o lunesdì, i sciensiæ da Stanford University School of Medicine an annonçiou l'invençion de un neuvo instrumento diagnòstico ch'o peu clascificâ e çellule pe meña: un sottî chip stampabile ch'o peu ëse produto con deuviâ de stampante inkjet standard, fòscia pe un çenteximo di SUA ognidun.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: I reçercatoî de ponta dixan che sto fæto chì o peu portâ à unna tempoia descoverta de cancao, tixi, HIV e maläia pe-i paçienti inti paixi à basso reddito, donde e speise pe-a sorvevivensa a-e moutie comme o cancao a-o sen peuan ëse a meitæ de quelle di paixi ciù mosci.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: O JAS 39C Gripen o s'é anæto à scciantâ contra unna pista verso e 9,30 am oa locale (0230 UTC) e o l'é scciuppou, con serrâ l'æriopòrto a-i xeui commersæ.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: O pilòtto o l'é stæto identificou comme o Cappo Squaddra Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: I media locali repòrtan che un caro de pompê de l'æriopòrto o s'é arrubattou tanto ch'o respondeiva.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: O 28enne Vidal o l'é introu into Barça che l'é træ saxoin, da Seviggia.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Da quande o l'é anæto inta capitale catalaña, o Vidal o l'à zugou 49 partie pe-o club.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: A protesta a l'é comensâ verso e 11,00 oa locale (UTC+1) à Whitehall, pe contra à l'intrâ sorveggiâ da-a Poliçia de Downing Street, a rescidensa offiçiâ do Primmo Ministro.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Pròpio dòppo 11.00 i manifestanti an bloccou o traffego in sciâ carrezzâ nòrd à Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: À 11,20, a poliçia a l'à domandou a-i manifestanti d'arretiâse in sciô marciapê, stante che aivan beseugno de balansâ o drito de protestâ co-o traffego ch'o s'ammuggiava.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Verso 11:29, a protesta a l'à lasciou Whitehall, passou Trafalgar Square, in sciô Strand, con passâ da Aldwych e sovia Kingsway verso Holborn, donde o Partio Conservatô ol'ea apreuvo à tegnî o seu Forum de Primmaveia, inte l'hotel Grand Connaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: O record testa à testa do Nadal contra o Canada o l'é de 7–2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Che no l'é guæi, o l'ò perso contra o Raonic inti Brisbane Open.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: O Nadal o l'à misso in stacca l'88% netto de ponti inta partia, con guägnâ 76 ponti into primmo servixo.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Dòppo a partia, o Re de Clay o l'à dito: “Son franco invexendou d'ëse torna inti gii finæ di eventi ciù importanti. Son chì pe çercâ à guägnâ sto chì”.
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: Panama Papers” o l'é un termine pægua pe pöcassæ dexe mioin de documenti do studdio legale panameise Mossack Fonseca, stæti passæ a-i giornali da primmaveia 2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: I documenti an fæto vedde che quattòrze banche an aggiuttou de casañe ricche à asconde ricchessa pe miliardi de dòllai US pe schivâ e tasce e de atre normative.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: O giornale britannico The Guardian o fa intende che a Deutsche Bank a controllava pöcassæ un terso de 1200 soçietæ de còmodo, stæte deuviæ pe combinâ sta cösa.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Gh'é stæto de proteste inte tutto o mondo, un muggio de proçedimenti penæ, e i cappi de governo de Islanda e Pakistan se son demissi tutti doî.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Nasciuo à Hong Kong, o Ma o l'à studdiou a-a New York University e inta Harvard Law School e tòsto o l'à ottegnuo unna “green card” americaña de rescidente permanente.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: O Hsieh o l'à inscinuou a-o tempo de eleçioin che o Ma poeise scappâ da-o paise in tempo de crixi.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: O Hsieh o l'argomentava ascì che o fotogenico Ma o foïse ciù forma che sostansa.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: À despeto de ste accusaçioin, o Ma o l'à guägno de lengê in sce unna ciattaforma chi domandava ligammi ciù streiti co-a moæ patria cineise.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: A-a giornâ d'ancheu o Zugou do Giorno o l'é o Alex Ovechkin di Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: O l'à fæto 2 goal e 2 assist into 5-3 à Washington guagno sovia i Atlanta Thrashers.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Inta seiaña, o primmo assist do Ovechkin o l'é stæto in sciô goal da vittöia da recluta Nicklas Backstrom;
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: o seu segondo goal da seiaña o l'ea o seu 60° da saxon, con vegnî à ëse o primmo zugou à totalizzâ 60 ò ciù goal inte unna saxon da-o 1995-96, quande o Jaromir Jagr e o Mario Lemieux an seghittou ciaschidun sta pria miggiæa.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Do 2008, o Batten o s'é clascificou o 190° inta lista di 400 americhen ciù ricchi, con unna fortuña astimmâ de $2.3 miliardi.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: O l'ea passou dottô into College of Arts & Sciences da Universcitæ da Virginia do 1950 e o l'ea un scignificativo donatô de quella instituçion.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: A prexon inte l'Iraq do Abu Ghraib a l'é stæta missa à feugo quande gh'ea un sollevo.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: A prexon a l'é stæta conosciua dòppo che l'abuxo in sciô prexonê o l'é stæto descoverto là, apreuvo che e fòrse US an avuo a megio.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: O Piquet Jr. o s'é scciantou into Grand Prix de Singapore do 2008, pròpio dòppo un pitstop tempoio pe-o Fernando Alonso, con portâ de feua a machina de seguessa.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Tòsto che e machine davanti a-o Alonso son anæte à pe carburante sotta a machina de seguessa, lê o l'à scompassou o gruppo pe piggiâ a vittöia.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: O Piquet Jr. o l'é stæto saccagnou dòppo o Gran Premmio d’Ongaia do 2009.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: À 8,46 preçise de mattin un scilençio o l'é cheito in sciâ çittæ, con marcâ o momento exatto che o primmo jet o l'à corpio o seu obiettivo.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Doî fasci de luxe en stæti montæ pe pontâ verso o çê inta neutte.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: A l'é in corso a construçion de çinque neuvi grattaçê in sciô pòsto, con un çentro transpòrti e un parco da memöia into mezo.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: A trasmiscion de l’emittente PBS a l’à guägno ciù de vintiquattro premmi Emmy, e inte l’insemme a l’à avuo unna duata ciù bassa solo che de Sesame Street e de Mister Rogers’ Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Ògni pontâ a se conçentrava in sce un argomento de un libbro specifico, esplorandolo pe mezo de ciù stöie.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Tutte e pontæ davan de recommendaçioin in scî libbri che i figgeu avieivan dovuo çercâ pe quand’anavan in biblioteca.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, de l’emittente Reading Raimbow (ch’a l’appartëgne a-o circuito WNED Buffalo) o l’à affermou che «Reading Raimbow a l’à mostrou a-i figgeu a raxon pe-a quæ beseugna leze, l’amô pe-a lettua... [o programma] o l’incoraggiva i figgeu à piggiâ un libbro inte moen e à lezilo».
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Çertidun, compreiso John Grant, creddan che a fin da serie a segge stæta provocâ da-a crixi di finançiamenti e da un cangio inta filosofia da programmaçion televixiva con finalitæ d’educaçion.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: A tempesta, scituâ pöcassæ à 645 miggia (1040 km) à ponente de isoe do Cao Verde, l'é façile ch'a se desperde avanti de menassâ quarche territöio, dixe e previxoin.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: A-o momento o Fred o gh'à di venti de 105 miggia l'oa (165 km/h) e o se mescia verso o nordoveste.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: O Fred o l'é o ciclon tropicale o ciù granio mai registrou mai tanto lonxi à sud e à est inte l'Atlantico, da quande gh'é de imagine satellitari, e solo che o terso ciù gròsso oragan registrou à levante do 35°W.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: A-i 24 de settembre 1759, o Arthur Guinness o l'à firmou un contræto de pixon de 9.000 anni pe-o louëio de bira St James' Gate, à Dublin, Irlanda.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: 250 anni apreuvo, a Guinness a l'é cresciua à un dafâ globale ch'o fa giâ ciù de 10 miliardi de euro (US$14.7 miliardi) tutti i anni.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: O Jonny Reid, co-pilòtto da squaddra A1GP New Zealand, ancheu o l'à fæto istöia, con ghiâ ciù a-a lesta da 48enne Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legalmente.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: O sciô Reid o l'é stæto bon da ghiâ a machina neozelandeise A1GP, Black Beauty à de lestixe de ciù de 160km/h sette vòtte in sciô ponte.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: A poliçia neozelandeise a l'à avuo de difficoltæ à deuviâ e seu pistòlle radar pe vedde comm'o l'anesse lesto o sciô Reid in caxon de comm'a l'é bassa a Black Beauty e a sola vòtta che a poliçia a l'é sciortia à cronometrâ o sciô Reid l'é stæto quande o l'à rallentou à 160/km/h.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Di urtimi 3 meixi, ciù de 80 arrestæ son stæti relasciæ da-a struttua Central Booking sensa ëse formalmente accaxonæ.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: L'arvî de st'anno, o giudiçe Glynn o l'à emisso un òrdine temporaneo de trattegnimento contra a struttua pe fâ respettâ o relascio de quelli che son stæti trattegnui ciù de 24 oe apreuvo a seu intrâ e che no an reçevuo unn'ödiensa da un commissäio do tribunâ.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: O commissäio o fissa a cauçion, s'a l'é conçessa, e o formalizza e accusaçioin presentæ da l'offiçiâ ch'o l'à effettuou l'arresto. E accusaçioin vëgnan dapeu inseie into scistema informatico do stato, donde o caxo o vëgne monitorou.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: L'ödiensa a segna ascì a dæta do drito de l'indagou à un debâ lesto.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: O Peter Costello, tesoê australian e òmmo ciù favoio à succede a-o primmo ministro John Howard comme cappo do partio Liberal o l'à manifestou a seu adexon pe unna industria à energia nucleare inte l'Australia.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: O sciô Costello o l'à dito che quande a geneaçion de l'energia nucleare a vëgne à ëse economicamente vitale, l'Australia a dovià perseguî o seu uso.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: “S'a vëgne à ëse commersâ, niatri devimo aveila. Veu dîse che no gh'é nisciuña obieçion de prinçipio à l'energia nucliâ” o l'à dito o sciô Costello.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Segondo l'Ansa, “a poliçia a l'ea allägnâ da unna pâ de corpi d'erto livello che aivan poia ch'a poesse fâ scciuppâ unna guæra de succescion à tutto campo.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: A poliçia a l'à dito che o Lo Piccolo o l'aiva o desciù, apreuvo ch'o l'ea stæto o brasso drito do Provenzano à Palermo e a seu ciù grande espeiensa a gh'à guagno o respetto de ciù vege geneaçioin di boss, dæto che perseguivan a politica do Provenzano de tegnîse o ciù basso che poeivan, tanto che menassavan a ræ do seu poei.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Sti boss ean stæti missi a-o passo da-o Provenzano quande o l'aiva misso fin a-a guæra stæta ghiâ da-o Riina contra o stato, ch'o reclamava e vitte di croxæ da mafia Giovanni Falcone e Paolo Borsellino do 1992.”
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: O CEO da Apple, Steve Jobs, o l'à presentou o dispoxitivo in camminâ in sciô parco e in tiâ feua l'iPhone de d'inta stacca di seu jeans.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Into seu descorso de 2 oe o l'à dito che “Ancheu a Apple a l'é apreuvo à inventâ torna o telefono, stemmo chì che femmo l'istöia, ancheu”.
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: O Braxî o l'é o ciù grande paise catòlico roman in sciâ Tæra e a Gexa catòlica romaña a s'è de longo oppòsta a-a legalizzaçion do maiezzo omosessuâ into paise.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: O Congresso Naçionale do Braxî o l'à dibattuo a legalizzaçion pe 10 anni e sti maiezzi çivili a-o momento son legali solo che into Rio Grande do Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: A leze originäia a l'é stæta sbossâ da-o scindico passou de São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. A legislaçion propòsta, dòppo ëse stæta emendâ, oua a l'é inte moen do Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: I manifestanti spean de accheugge unna petiçion de 1,2 mioin de firme da presentâ a-o Congresso naçionâ à novembre.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Apreuvo che l'é vegnuo ciæo che un muggio de famigge çercavan aggiutto legale pe scombatte i sbratti, a-i 20 de marso s'é tegnuo un incontro à l'East Bay Community Law Center pe-e vittime da ghimiña di sciti.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Tòsto che i inquilin an comensou contandose quello che gh'ea intravegnuo, e ciù tante de famigge, stæte arrestæ ingheuggeite, s'en addæte a-a cheita che a Carolyn Wilson de l'OHA a l'aiva arröbou i seu depòxiti de seguessa, e a se n'é anæta de d'in çittæ.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: I inquilin de Lockwood Gardens se creddan che ghe pòsse ëse atre 40 ò ciù famigge à affrontâ o sbratto, dæto ch'an sacciuo che a poliçia de l'OHA a l'é apreuvo à indagâ ascì in sce de atre propietæ de sciti pubrichi à Oakland, che porrieivan ëse mescciæ inta ghimiña di sciti.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: A band a l'à scassou o spettacolo a-o War Memorial Stadium de Maui, ch'o doveiva ëse frequentou da 9.000 persoñe, e a l'à ciammou scuse a-i fan.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: A soçietæ de gestion da band, HK Management Inc., a no l'à dæto nisciuña raxon iniçiâ quande an scassou a-i 20 de settembre, ma a l'à accaxonou de raxoin logistiche o giorno apreuvo.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: I avvoxæ avvocati greghi, o Sakis Kechagioglou e o George Nikolakopoulos son stæti missi drento inta prexon do Korydallus de Atene, pe ëse stæti attrovæ corpeivi de concuscion e de corruçion.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Comme conseguensa de sto fæto, l'é vegnuo feua un gròsso ciæto inta communitæ legale grega, traverso l'espoxiçion de açioin inleçite che giudiçi, avvocati, procuoei, pubrichi ministëi, an compio inti anni avanti.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Da pöco settemañe, dòppo a notiçia pubricâ da-o giornalista Makis Triantafylopoulos inta seu popolâ transmiscion televixiva “Zoungla” de Alpha TV, o membro do parlamento e avvocato Petros Mantouvalos o s'ea demisso, apreuvo che di membri do seu offiçio ean stæti ingheuggeiti inte inleçiti de concuscion e corruçion.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Pe de ciù, o mascimo giudiçe Evangelos Kalousis o l'é stæto imprexonou pe ëse stæto attrovou corpeive de corruçion e de comportamento degenerou.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Con deçixon, o Roberts o l'à refuou de dî quande o se credde che comense a vitta, unna domanda importante quande s'appense à l'etica de l'abòrdo, con dî che no saieiva etico commentâ in sciô speçifico de caxi poscibili.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Tutte e mainee, o l'à resegondou a seu primma diciaraçion che Roe v. Wade a l'ea “a leze permanente da tæra”, in enfatizzâ l'importansa de deçixoin conscistente da Corte Supremma.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: O l'à confirmou ascì ch'o credde into drito impliçito a-a privatessa, da-o quæ a depende a deçixon do Roe.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: O Maroochydore o l'aiva finio in çimma a-a scaa, sei ponti netti da-o Noosa a-o segondo pòsto.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: E doe parte se incontrieivan inta semifinâ maggiô, donde o Noosa o l'à misso feua i vinçitoî da 11 ponti.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: O Maroochydore dapeu o l'à battuo o Caboolture into finâ preliminâ.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: L'Hesperonychus elizabethae a l'é unna speçie da famiggia Dromaeosauridae e o l'é un coxin do Velociraptor .
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Se creddeiva che st'öxello da preda pin de ciumme e à sangue cado o l'æse camminou drito in sce doe gambe con de ciöte comme o Velociraptor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: A seu segonda ciöta a l'ea ciù gròssa, in dâ origine a-o nomme Hesperonychus, ch'o veu dî “ciöta de ponente”.
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: In azzonta a-a giassa chi se fregoggiava, e condiçioin de tempo estremme an impedio i sfòrsci di soccorsci.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: O Pittman o l'à fæto accapî che e condiçioin no megioian scin a-a pròscima settemaña.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: A quantitæ e o spessô da giassa da banchixa, segondo o Pittman, son i pezo che ghe segge stæto pe-i caccioei de fòche inti 15 anni passæ.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Ancheu, tanto che se tegniva o morteuio de Jeff Weise e de træ de neuve vittime, tra e gente do Red Lake s’é spantegou a notiçia de l’arresto de un atro studente, lê ascì interessou into massacro scolastico à corpi d’arma da feugo intravegnuo a-i 21 de marso passæ.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: E autoritæ no an fæto atre deciaraçioin a-o de là da conferma de l’arresto d’ancheu.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: À tutti i mòddi, unna fonte ch’a conosce e investigaçioin in corso a l’à confiou a-o Star-Tribune de Minneapolis che se trattieiva de Luis Jordan, o figgio de sezz’anni de Floyd Jordan, ch’o l’à a carrega de «tribal chairman» into commun de Red Lake.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: No se sa ancon, inte sto momento, che accuse ghe saià diretto ò cös’o l’à portou e autoritæ à sospettâ do zoveno, ma e açioin giudiäçie in matëia de minoî d’etæ en za stæte avviæ inta corte federale.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: O Lodin o l'à dito ascì che i offiçiæ an deçiso de scassâ o ballottaggio pe sarvâ i afghen da-a speisa e o reisego de unn'atra eleçion.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: I diplomatichi an dito che an attrovou à basta ambiguitæ inta constituçion afgaña pe determinâ che o ballottaggio o no l'ea neçessäio.
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Sto fæto o contradixe i primmi rappòrti, che divan che scassâ o ballottaggio saieiva stæto contra a constituçion.
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: L'aeromòbile o l'ea stæto portou à Irkutsk e ghe davan recatto de squaddre interne.
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: L'é stæto nominou unna commiscion inquirente pe indagâ.
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: O Il-76 o l'é stæto un importante componente de arme Rusce e Sovietiche scin da-i anni '70, e o l'aiva za visto un greive açidente in Ruscia o meise passou.
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: A-i 7 d'ottobre un motô o s'ea destaccou a-o decòllo, sensa feii. A Ruscia a l'à misso à tæra a-a lesta i Il-76 dòppo quell'açidente.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: 800 miggia do Trans-Alaska Pipeline System ean stæte serræ, apreuvo à unna perdia de miggiæa de barrî de petròlio grezzo, à sude de Fairbanks, inte l'Alaska.
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Unn'interruçion da corrente apreuvo à un test de routine do scistema antinçendio a l'à provocou l'avertua de valvole de scarrego e o petròlio grezzo o l'é anæto de sovia, da-a vexin a-a staçion de pompaggio 9 de Fort Greely.
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: E valvole averte an consentio un relascio de prescion pe-o scistema e o petròlio o l'é strixellou in sce un revestimento à unna vasca chi peu tegnî 55.000 barrî (2.3 mioin de galloin).
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Comme l'ea mäcordì poidisnâ, e avertue da vasca coavan ancon, probabilmente pe l'espanscion termica drento a vasca.
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Unn'atra area segondäia de contegnimento sotta e vasche, boña de tegnî 104.500 barrî a no l'ea ancon impia inte tutta a seu capaçitæ.
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: I commenti, da-o vivo in televixon, ean a primma vòtta che de importante fonte iraniañe aivan ammisso che e sançioin aveivan quarche effetto.
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Comprendan de restriçioin finançiäie e o bando da parte de l'Union Europea in sce l'esportaçion do petròlio grezzo, da-o quæ l'economia iraniaña a reçeive l'80% de seu intræ foestee.
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: Into seu ciù reçente rappòrto menscile, l'OPEC a l'à dito che l'esportaçion do grezzo a l'é chinâ a-i seu livelli ciù basci da doî dexenni à 2.8 mioin de barrî a-o giorno.
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: O supremmo leader do paise, l'Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, o l'à descrito a dependensa da-o petròlio comme “unna ciappoa” à partî da primma da revoluçion islamica de l'Iran do 1979 e da-a quæ o paise o se dovieiva libeâ.
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Quande a capsulla a l'arriva a-a Tæra e a l'intra inte l'atmosfea, pöcassæ à 5am (oa do levante) a dovieiva açende à reo unna trassa de luxe pe-e gente da California do settentrion, Oregon, Nevada e Utah.
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: A capsula a parrià pròpio comme unna meteora ch'a vagghe traverso o çê.
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: A capsula a viægiâ pöcassæ à 12,8 km ò 8 miggia a-o segondo, lesta basta pe anâ da San Francisco à Los Angeles inte un menuto.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust a stabiliâ un neuvo record de tutti i tempi pe ëse a ciù lesta navetta spaçiale à tornâ in sciâ tæra, in batte o record stabilio in avanti, à mazzo do 1969, a-o retorno do modulo de commando de l'Apollo X.
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: «A passià de d'ato a-a còsta de ponente da Califòrnia do settentrion e a rescciæià o çê da-a Califòrnia traverso l'Oregon do mezo e sciù, traverso o Nevada, l'Idaho e into Utah», o l'à dito o Tom Duxbury, direttô do progetto Stardust.
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: A deçixon do sciô Rudd de firmâ l'accòrdio in sciô clima de Kyoto a l'isoa i Stati Unii, che oua saian l'unica naçion sviluppâ à no ratificâ l'accòrdio.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: O passou governo conservatô de l'Australia o s'é refuou de ratificâ Kyoto, in dî ch'o dannezzieiva l'economia co-a seu pesoña dependensa da-e esportaçioin de carbon, tanto che di paixi comme l'India e a Ciña no ean ligæ da-i obiettivi de emiscion.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: O l'é o ciù gròsso accatto inte l'istöia de eBay.
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: A soçietæ a spea de diverscificâ e seu fonte de profito e guägnâ popolaritæ inte aree donde Skype a mantëgne unna poxiçion fòrte, comme a Ciña, l'Euròpa de levante e o Braxî.
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Sciensiæ an sospettou che Encelado o segge giologicamente attivo e unna poscibile fonte de l'anello giassou E de Saturno.
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Encelado o l'é l'oggetto ciù reflettente into scistema soâ, perché o respegia pöcassæ o 90 in sce çento da luxe soâ, ch'a ô corpisce.
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: L'editô de zeughi Konami o l'à diciarou ancheu inte un giornale giapaneise che no realizzian o zeugo Six Days in Fallujah.
text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: O zeugo o l'é basou in sciâ segonda battaggia de Fallujah, unna gramma battaggia tra americhen e fòrse iracheñe.
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: L'ACMA a l'à descoverto ascì che, sciben che o video o l'ea stæto transmisso in streaming in sce l'Internet, o Grande Fræ o no l'aiva violou e leze in sciâ çensua di contegnui online, aprevuo che i media no ean stæti memorizzæ in sciô scito web do Grande Fræ.
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: O Broadcasting Services Act o s'interessa da regolaçion di contegnui Internet; tutte e mainee, pe ëse conscideâ un contegnuo Internet, unna cösa a deve fixicamente attrovâse in sce un server.
text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: L'ambasciâ di Stati Unii à Nairobi, Kenya, a l'à dæto l'avvertimento che “di estremisti da Somalia” stan che progettan de allansâ di attacchi bomboe suiçidi into Kenya e inte l'Etiòpia.
text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: I SUA dixan che an reçevuo l'informaçion da unna fonte coverta ch'a mensuña speçificatamente o deuvio de bombezzoei suiçidi pe fâ sätâ “importanti bersali” inte l'Etiòpia e o Kenya.
text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Ben ben avanti The Daily Show e The Colbert Report, Heck e Johnson aivan imaginou unna pubricaçion ch'a voeiva parodiâ i giornali – e a mainea de reportâ e notiçie – quande ean studenti à UW do 1988.
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Fin da-o seu comenso, The Onion a l'é vegnua à ëse un vertadeo impëio da parodia do giornaliximo, con unn'ediçion à stampa, un scito web ch'o l'à attiou 5.000.000 vixitatoî solo che into meise d'ottobree, personali ads, un network de notiçie à 24 oe, podcasts, e un atlante do mondo, stæto allansou che no l'é guæi, stæto ciammou Our Dumb World.
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: O Al Gore e o generale Tommy Franks destegavan à caxo i seu titoli favoii (se parlava do Gore, quande The Onion o reportava che lê e a Tipper favan o megio sesso da seu vitta, dòppo a seu perdia do 2000 into collegio elettorale).
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Tanti di seu autoî an continuou à exerçitâ unna grande influensa in scî spettacoli de parodie giornalistiche do Jon Stewart e o Stephen Colbert.
text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text: L'evento artistico o l'é ascì parte de unna campagna do Commun de Bucharest ch'o çerca à relansâ l'imagine da capitale romeña comme unna metropoli creativa e coloria.
text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text: A çittæ a saià a primma inte l'Euròpa do sud-est à ospitâ CowParade, o ciù grande evento artistico do mondo, tra zugno e agosto de st'anno chì.
text_en: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.

text: L'annonçio de ancheu o l'à esteiso ascì l'impegno do governo, stæto fæto à marso de st'anno, pe finançiâ vettue extra.
text_en: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text: Unn'azzonta de 300 a pòrta o totale à 1.300 vettue da accattâ pe contrastâ o sorvammuggiamento.
text_en: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.

text: O Christopher Garcia, un portavoxe do departamento de poliçia de Los Angeles, o l'à dito che o sospetto offensô masccio o vëgne indagou pe desubbidiensa ciutòsto che pe vandaliximo.
text_en: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.

text: O segnâ o no l'ea fixicamente dannezzou; a modifica a l'é stæta fæta con deuviâ di çeiòtti neigri, decoræ co-i segni da paxe e di cheu, pe alterâ a “O”, tanto da lezila eventualmente “e”.
text_en: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".

text: A marea rossa a l'é provocâ da unna conçentraçion ciù erta che o normâ de Karenia brevis, un organiximo mæn uniçellulâ, ch'o s'attreuva in natua.
text_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

text: I fattoî natuæ se peuan intersecâ pe produe e condiçioin ideale, che permettan à st'æga chì de cresce dramaticamente de numeo.
text_en: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.

text: L'æga a produe unna neurotosciña ch'a peu dannezzâ i nervi segge inti òmmi che inti pesci.
text_en: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.

text: De spesso i pesci meuan apreuvo à l'erta conçentraçion da tosciña inte l'ægua.
text_en: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.

text: I umoen peuan ammoutîse pe avei sciorbio de l'ægua inquinâ, stæta portâ inte l'äia da-o vento e da-i mouxi.
text_en: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.

text: A-o seu mascimo, o çiclon tropicâ Gonu, coscì stæto aciammou da unna borsa de feugge de parma inta lengua de Maldive, o l'é arrivou à di venti sostegnui de 240 chillòmetri l'oa (149 miggia à l'oa) .
text_en: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) .

text: Da ancheu fito, i venti ean pöcassæ à 83 km/h, e s'aspeta che comensan à ammermâ.
text_en: By early today, winds were around 83 km/h, and it was expect to keep weakening.

text: De mäcordì, a United States' National Basketball Association (NBA) a l'à sospeiso a seu saxon profescionâ de basket pe di lägni in ponto COVID-19.
text_en: On Wednesday, the United States' National Basketball Association (NBA) suspended its professional basketball season due to concerns regarding COVID-19.

text: A deçixon da NBA a l'é vegnua apreuvo che un zugou di Utah Jazz o l'é resultou poxitivo a-o virus COVID-19.
text_en: The NBA's decision followed a Utah Jazz player testing positive for the COVID-19 virus.

text: In base à sto fòscile, veu dîse che che a scission a l'avvëgne ben ben ciù fito de quante l'é stæto anteçipou da-e preuve molecolæ.
text_en: "Based on this fossil, that means the split is much earlier than has been anticipated by the molecular evidence.

text: “Veu dîse che tutto dev'ëse misso in derê,” o l'à dito o reçercatô a-o Rift Valley Research Service inte l'Etiòpia e co-autô do studdio, o Berhane Asfaw.
text_en: That means everything has to be put back," said researcher at the Rift Valley Research Service in Ethiopia and a co-author of the study, Berhane Asfaw.

text: Fin'oua, AOL o l'é stæto bon da mesciâse e sviluppâ o mercou IM a-o pròpio ritmo, in caxon da seu grande diffuxon inti Stati Unii.
text_en: Until now, AOL has been able to move and develop the IM market at its own pace, due to its widespread use within the United States.

text: Con st'accòrdio chì, sta libertæ a porriæ finî.
text_en: With this arrangement in place, this freedom might end.

text: O numeo di utenti di servixi Yahoo! e Microsoft insemme o rivalezziâ co-o numeo de casañe AOL.
text_en: The number of users of the Yahoo! and Microsoft services combined will rival the number of AOL's customers.

text: A Northern Rock bank a l'ea stæta naçionalizzâ do 2008, apreuvo a-a descoverta che a soçietæ a l'aiva reçevuo do sostëgno d'emergensa da-o governo do UK.
text_en: The Northern Rock bank had been nationalised in 2008 following the revelation that the company had received emergency support from the UK Government.

text: Northern Rock a l'à avuo de beseugno d'aggiutto, in caxon da seu espoxiçion durante a crixi de ipoteche subprime do 2007.
text_en: Northern Rock had required support due to its exposure during the subprime mortgage crisis in 2007.

text: O Virgin Group de Sir Richard Branson o l'aiva unn'offerta pe-a banca, stæta refuâ avanti a naçionalizzaçion da banca.
text_en: Sir Richard Branson's Virgin Group had a bid for the bank rejected prior to the bank’s nationalisation.

text: Do 2010, tanto ch'a vegniva naçionalizzâ, l'attuâ banca Northern Rock plc a l'é stæta spartia da-a 'gramma banca', Northern Rock (organizzaçion de patrimòni).
text_en: In 2010, while nationalised, the current high street bank Northern Rock plc was split from the ‘bad bank’, Northern Rock (Asset Management).

text: O Virgin o l'aiva solo che aquixio a "boña banca" Northern Rock, e no a compagnia de organizzaçion de patrimòni.
text_en: Virgin have only purchased the ‘good bank’ of Northern Rock, not the asset management company.

text: Sta chì se pensa ch'a segge a quinta vòtta inte l'istöia che de gente aggian osservou che quello ch'o s'é rivelou ëse do mateiâ, stæto confirmou chimicamente comme marçian, o cazzeiva in sciâ tæra.
text_en: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth.

text: Tra e 24.000 meteorite conosciue che seggian cheite in sciâ tæra, solo che 34 son stæte verificæ d'ëse marçiañe d'origine.
text_en: Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin.

text: Chinze de ste ròcche son attriboie a-a cheita de meteorite do luggio passou.
text_en: Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July.

text: Quarchiduña de ròcche, che son do bello ræe in sciâ tæra, en stæte vendue da US$11.000 à $22.500 à l'onsa, che l'é pöcassæ dexe vòtte de ciù che o costo de l'öo.
text_en: Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.

text: Dòppo a corsa, o Keselowski o l'arresta in testa a-o campionato di pilòtti con 2.250 ponti.
text_en: Following the race, Keselowski remains the Drivers' Championship leader with 2,250 points.

text: Sette ponti in derê, o Johnson o l'é segondo con 2.243.
text_en: Seven points behind, Johnson is second with 2,243.

text: In tersa, o Hamlin o l'é vinti ponti in derê, ma çinque avanti do Bowyer. O Kahne e o Truex, Jr. son quinti e sesti, respettivamente con 2.220 e 2.207 ponti.
text_en: In third, Hamlin is twenty points behind, but five ahead of Bowyer. Kahne and Truex, Jr. are fifth and sixth respectively with 2,220 and 2,207 points.

text: O Stewart, o Gordon, o Kenseth, e o Harvick gian d'in gio a-e poxiçioin di primmi dexe pe-o campionato di pilòtti, co-e quattro corse ch'arresta inta saxon.
text_en: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, and Harvick round out the top-ten positions for the Drivers' Championship with four races remaining in the season.

text: A US Navy ascì a l'à dito che son apreuvo à indagâ in sce l'açidente.
text_en: The US Navy also said they were investigating the incident.

text: An dito ascì inte unna diciaraçion: “A-o momento l'accopaggio o l'é apreuvo à travaggiâ pe attrovâ a megio mainea de tiâ sciù a nave in seguessa.”
text_en: They also said in a statement, "The crew is currently working to determine the best method of safely extracting the ship".

text: Nave de miñe de contramesua da classe Avenger, a nave a l'ea in sciâ seu rotta verso Puerto Princesa into Palawan.
text_en: An Avenger class mine countermeasures ship, the ship was on its way to Puerto Princesa in Palawan.

text: A l'é assegnâ a-o Setten Steu da U.S. Navy e a l'à a base à Sasebo, Nagasaki into Giapan.
text_en: It is assigned to the U.S. Navy’s Seventh Fleet and based in Sasebo, Nagasaki in Japan.

text: I aggressoî de Mumbai en arrivæ pe nave a-i 26 de novembre 2008, in portâ con lô de granate e de arme automatiche e an corpio bersaggi mortipri, compreisa a staçion da ferrovia Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus piña de gente e l'avvoxou Taj Mahal Hotel.
text_en: The Mumbai attackers arrived via boat on Novemeber 26, 2008, bringing with them grenades, automatic weapons and hit multiple targets including the crowded Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus railway station and the famous Taj Mahal Hotel.

text: L'esploraçion e a cheuggeita de informaçioin do David Headley an aggiuttou à permette l'opeaçion di 10 terroristi do groppo militante pakistan Laskhar-e-Taiba.
text_en: David Headley's scouting and information gathering had helped to enable the operation by the 10 gunmen from the Pakistani militant group Laskhar-e-Taiba.

text: L'attacco o mette unna fòrte tenscion tra l'india e o Pakistan.
text_en: The attack put a huge strain on relations between India and Pakistan.

text_en: Chiao and Sharipov reported being a safe distance from the attitude adjustment thrusters.

text_en: Russian ground control activated the jets and normal attitude of the station was regained.

text: O caxo o l'à continuou inta Virginia, apreuvo ch'a l'é a sede do provider, leader inti servixi internet AOL, a soçietæ ch'à l'à intentou a causa.
text_en: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

text: Sta chì a l'é a primma vòtta che unna condaña a l'é stæta ottegnua con deuviâ a legislaçion emanâ do 2003 pe limitâ a bulk e-mail, saiva à dî a spam, da-a distribuçion indexiderâ inte caselle e-mail di utenti.
text_en: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

text: O 21enne Jesus o l'é introu into Manchester City l'anno passou do zenâ 2017 da-o club braxilian Palmeiras pe un compenso chi se dixe de £27 mioin.
text_en: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

text: Scin da aloa, o braxilian o l'à zugou inte 53 partie pe-a squaddra inte tutte e competiçioin e o l'à totalizzou 24 goal.
text_en: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text: O Dr. Lee o l'à manifestou a seu preoccupaçion apreuvo a-e notiçie che di figgeu inta Turchia son stæti oua infettæ da-o virus de l'influensa aviäia A(H5N1), sensa ammoutîse.
text_en: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text: Gh'é di studdi che suggeriscian comme a moutia a l'à da vegnî ciù pöco mortale, avanti ch'a pòsse provocâ unn'epidemia globale, o fa osservâ.
text_en: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text: Gh'é o lägno che i paçienti pòssan continuâ à infettâ ciù gente inte l'anâ avanti co-e seu attivitæ cotidiañe, se i scintomi de l'influensa arrestan legi.
text_en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: O Leslie Aun, portavoxe da Komen Foundation, o l'à dito che l'organizzaçion a l'à adeuttou unna neuva regola ch'a no consente di aggiutti ò de cheuggeite de fondi pe avvardâse da de organizzaçioin che seggian sotta indagine penâ.
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: E regole de Komen desqualifican Planned Parenthood, in caxon de unn'indagine pendente in sce comme Planned Parenthood a spende e a ten conto di seu dinæ, ch'a ven portâ avanti da l'avvocato Cliff Stearns.
text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: O Stearns o l'indaga se e tasce vëgnan deuviæ pe finançiâ di abòrdi pe mezo de Planned Parenthood, into seu ròllo de prescidente do Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, chi stà sotta o pægua da House Energy and Commerce Committee.
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: O passou governatô do Massachusetts, Mitt Romney o l'à guagno l'eleçion primmäia prescidençiale do Partio Repubrican mätesdì, con ciù do 46 in sce çento di voti.
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: O passou speaker da camia USA Newt Gingrich o l'é arrivou segondo co-o 32 in sce çento.
text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Da stato piggiatutto, a Florida a l'à assegnou tutti e çinquanta i seu delegæ a-o Romney, con sponciâlo in çimma comme òmmo de ponta pe-a nomination do Partio Repubrican.
text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: I organizzatoî da protesta an dito che pöcassæ 100.000 persoñe se son presentæ inte de çittæ tedesche comme Berlin, Colònia, Amburgo e Hannover.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: À Berlin a poliscia a l’à stimmou 6.500 manifestanti.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: De proteste gh’en stæte ascì à Pariggi, à Sofia in Bulgaria, à Vilnius in Lituania, a-a Valletta à Malta, à Tallinn in Estònia e à Edimburgo e Glasgow in Scòçia.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: À Londra 200 persoñe pöcassæ an protestou feua de çerti tra i offiçi di ciù importanti detentoî de copyright.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: O meise passou gh’é stæto de fòrte proteste in Polònia contra a firma do paise de l’accòrdio ACTA, apreuvo a-e quæ o governo polacco o l’à deçiso, pe-o momento, de no ratificâ l’accòrdio.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Tanto a Lettònia comme a Slovacchia an deciso de postiçipâ l’intrâ inte l’area ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Animal Liberation e a Royal Society for the prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) domandan torna l'installaçion obbligatöia de telecamie à çircuito serrou inte tutti i maxelli australien.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: L'inspettô cappo da RSPCA do New South Wales, David O'Shannessy, o l'à dito a-a ABC che a sorveggiansa e e ispeçioin di maxelli dovieivan ëse commuin inte l'Australia.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: “O CCTV o mandieiva de seguo un fòrte segnâ a-e persoñe, che travaggia co-e bestie, che o seu bon stâ o l'à a mascima prioritæ.”
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: A mappa di terramòtti do Çentro Geològico di Stati Unii o no l’aiva segnallou di terramòtti in Islanda pe-a settemaña primma.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: In azzonta, o Departamento meteorològico d’Islanda o no l’à segnallou di fenòmeni de terramòtto inte 48 oe passæ.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: I scignificativi fenòmeni de terramòtto ligæ a-a fase de cangio se son verificæ a-i 10 de marso inta parte de nòrd-est da cädea do vorcan.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: A-a base da montagna l’é stæto segnallou a presensa de nuvie neigre desligæ da l’attivitæ do vorcan.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: E nuvie an provocou unna poscibile confuxon in sciô fæto che ghe fïse stæto in davei unn’eruçion.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: O Luno o l'aiva 120-160 metri cubbi de carburante à bòrdo quand'o s'é rompio e I venti fòrti e i mòuxi l'an sponciou into franzimâ.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Di elicòtteri an sarvou i dozze membri de l'accopaggio e o solo danno o l'é stæto un naso rotto.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: O barco de 100 metri o l'ea in viægio pe cheugge o seu sòlito carrego de fertilizzanti e a-o prinçipio I fonçionäi temmeivan che o barco o poesse imbösâ o carrego.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: L'emendamento propòsto o l'é za passou inte tutti doî i rammi do parlamento do 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Un cangiamento o l'é stæto fæto inte sta sescion legislativa, quande a segonda frase a l'é stæta scassâ, avanti da-a Camia di Rappresentanti e dapeu a l'é stæta approvâ inte unna forma scimile da-o Senato a-o lunesdì.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: O fallimento da segonda frase, chi propoñe de vietâ e unioin çivile tra persoñe do mæximo sesso, o porrieiva eventualmente arvî a pòrta a-e unioin çivile in avvegnî.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Dòppo o debâ, l'HJR-3 o saià revisto torna da-a pròscima legislatua elezzua do 2015 ò do 2016 pe arrestâ in corso.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: I succesci do Vautier a-o de feua da regia comprendan un sciòpero da famme do 1973 contra quella ch'o consciderava unna çensua politica.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: A leze franseise a l'é stæta cangiâ. O seu attiviximo o remonta à l'etæ de 15 anni, qunde o s'é unio a-a Rescistensa, durante a segonda guæra mondiale.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: O l'à documentou lê mæximo inte un libbro do 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Di anni 1960 o l'é tornou inte l'Algeria, ch’a l’ea independente da no guæi, pe mostrâ regia cinematografica.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: O judoka giapaneise Hitoshi Saito, vinçitô de doe medagge olimpiche, o l'é mòrto à l'etæ de 54 anni.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: A causa da mòrte a l'é stæta annonçiâ comme cancao do dòtto biliare intraepatico.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: O l'é mòrto à Osaka mätesdì.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: In ciù d'ëse un ex campion olimpico mondiale, o Saito o l'ea o prescidente da commiscion de allenamento da All Japan Judo Federation a-o momento da seu mòrte.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: A-o manco 100 persoñe aivan aspëtou a festa, pe festezzâ o primmo anniversäio da cobbia, da quæ o maiezzo o s'é tegnuo l'anno passou.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Un evento formale pe l'anniversäio o l'ea in programma pe unna dæta ciù in là, dixe e autoritæ.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: A cobbia a s'ea maiâ into Texas che l'é un anno, e a l'é vegnua à Buffalo pe festezzâ con amixi e pænti.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: O maio de 30 anni, ch'o l'ea nasciuo à Buffalo, o l'ea un di quattro stæti ammassæ inta sparatöia, ma seu moggê a no l'ea stæta feia.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: O Karno o l'é un ben conosciuo, ma controverso meistro de ingreise, ch'o mostrava sotta Modern Education and King's Glory, ch'o proclamava d'avei 9.000 studenti a-o curmine da seu carrea.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Inte seu nòtte o deuviava de poule che quarche genitô o conscideava sgreuzze, se dixe ch'o foïse sòlito giastemmâ in classe.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education a l'à accaxonou de stampâ de gròsse pubricitæ in scî bus sensa autorizzaçion e de mentî, con dî ch'o l'ea l'insegnante cappo de ingleise.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: In avanti, o l'ea stæto accaxonou ascì de violaçion do copyright, ma o no l'ea stæto incriminou.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un ex studdente o l'à dito che “o deuviava o slang inta classe, o mostrava e matëie di appontamenti inte nòtte e o l'ea pròpio comme l'amigo di studdenti.”
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Durante i urtimi trei dexenni, con tutto che a segge arrestâ offiçialmente un stato communista, a Ciña a l'à sviluppou unn'economia de mercou.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: E primme reforme econòmiche son stæte fæte sotta a leadership do Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Da aloa, o peiso econòmico da Ciña o l'é cresciuo de 90 vòtte.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Pe-a primma vòtta, l'urtimo anno a Ciña a l'à esportou ciù machine che a Germania e a l'à scompassou i Stati Unii comme ciù gròsso mercou pe st'industria chì.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: O GDP da Ciña o porrieiva ëse ciù gròsso che quello di Stati Unii drento doî dexenni.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: A tempesta tropicale Danielle, nomme da quarta tempesta tropicale da saxon di oraghen atlantichi 2010, a s'é formâ inte l'Oceano Atlantico orientale.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: A tempesta, stæta localizzâ à pöcassæ 3.000 miggia da Miami, into Florida, a l'à di venti mascimi sostegnui de 40 mph (64 kph).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: I sciensiæ do National Hurricane Center anteveddan che Danielle a se raffòrsià à oragan da mäcordì.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Scicomme a tempesta a l'é lontan da-e ciazze, arresta de grammo valutâ o potençiale impatto in scî Stati Unii ò i Caraibi.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Nasciuo inta capitale croata, Zagabria, o Bobek o s'à guägno notorietæ quand'o zugava pe-o Partizan Belgrade.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: O gh'é introu do 1945 e o gh'é stæto scin a-o 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Durante a seu permanensa inta squaddra, o l'à totalizzou 403 goal inte 468 occaxoin.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Nisciun atro a l'à mai fæto ciù appariçioin ò totalizzou ciù goal pe-o club che o Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Do 1995 o l'é stæto votou comme o megio zugou inte l'istöia do Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: E çelebraçioin son comensæ con un spettacolo speciale do gruppo Cirque du Soleil, conosciuo inte tutto o mondo.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: O l'é stæto seguio da-a Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, unna banda de giannisseri, e i cantanti Erkoç e Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Dapeu, i Dervisci Rotanti an piggiou a scena.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: A diva turca Sezen Aksu a s'é exibia co-o tenô italian Alessandro Safina e o cantante grego Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Pe finî, o gruppo de dansa turco Feugo d'Anatòlia o l'à rappresentou o spettacolo “Troy”.
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: O Peter Lenz, un corridô de 13 anni de motoçicli, o l'é mòrto dòppo ëse coinvòlto inte un açidente a-o Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Durante o seu gio de rescädamento, o Lenz o l'é cheito d'in sciâ seu mòto, e o l'é stæto dapeu corpio da-o collega Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: O l'é stæto soccorrio de drito da-o seu staff mego ch'o ô seguiva, e o l'é stæto portou à un uspiâ locale, donde ciù tardi o l'é mòrto.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: O Zayat o no s'ea fæto ninte inte l'açidente.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: In ponto scituaçion finançiäia globale, o Zapatero o l'à continuou dindo che “o scistema finançiäio o l'é unna parte de l'economia, unna parte cruçiale.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Emmo avuo unn'annosa crixi finançiäia, ch'a l'à avuo o seu momento ciù aspio i doî meixi passæ, e m'appenso oua che i mercoei finançiäi comensan à repiggiâse.”
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: A settemaña passâ, Naked News a l'à annonçiou ch'a l'avieiva ingrandio de brutto o seu incarrego in lengua internaçionale pe-e notiçie, con træ neuve trasmiscioin.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Za in ingleise e giapaneise, l'organizzaçion globale a l'é apreuvo à allansâ di programmi in spagnòllo, italian e corean, pe-a televixon, o web e i dispoxitivi mòbili.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Pe fortuña mi no m'é accapitou ninte, ma ò visto unna scena macabra, tanto che e gente çercavan à rompî i barcoin pe sciortî.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: E gente piccavan inti veddri co-e carreghe, ma i barcoin ean infrangibili.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “In sciâ fin, un di veddri o s'é rompio e an comensou à sciortî de da-o barcon”, o l'à dito o sorvevisciuo Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: E stelle mandan da luxe e do calô apreuvo à l'energia produta quande i atomi de idrògeno se fondan (ò son fuxi) insemme pe formâ di elementi ciù pesoin.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: I sciensiæ stan che travaggian à creâ un reattô ch'o peu fâ de l'energia a-a mæxima mainea.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Sto chì, tutte e mainee, o l'é un problema ben ben de grammo resciòrve e ghe vorrià ben ben de anni, avanti de vedde construti di reattoî à fuxon che vëgnan ben.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: L'agoggia d'äsâ a gallezza in sce l'ægua in caxon da tenscion da superficie.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: A tenscion de superficie a gh'é perché e molecole de l'ægua a-a superficie de l'ægua son ciù fortemente attiæ uña verso l'atra de quante o seggian e molecole de l'äia de d'ato à lô.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: E molecole d'ægua forman unna pelle invixibile de d'ato à l'ægua, chi permette à de cöse comme l'agoggia de gallezzâ in sciâ çimma de l'ægua.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: A lamma de un moderno pattino da giassa a l'à doî bòrdi con unna cavitæ coppua tra de lô. I doî bòrdi permettan unna megio preisa da gaissa, mæximo quande o l'é inclinou.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Apreuvo che a banda de sotta da lamma a l'é un pittin ingombâ, tòsto che a lamma a se ceiga da un lou ò da l'atro, o bòrdo ch'o l'é in contatto co-a giassa o se ingomba ascì.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Sto fæto o caxoña a rotaçion do pattinatô. Se i pattini se ceigan à drita, o pattinatô o gia à drita, se i pattini se ceigan à manciña, o pattinatô o gia à manciña.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pe anâ torna a-o seu livello d'energia preçedente, devan libeâse de l'energia extra ch'an reçevuo da-a luxe.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ô fan con mandâ feua unna minuscola partiçella de luxe, stæta acciammâ “foton”.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: I sciensiæ acciamman sto proçesso “emiscion stimolâ de radiaçion” apreuvo che i atomi son stimolæ da-a luxe brillante, in caxonâ l'emiscion de un foton de luxe, e a luxe a l'é unna smersa de radiaçion.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: L'imagine apreuvo a ne fa vedde i atomi che mandan feua di fotoin. Naturalmente, inte realtæ i fotoin son ben ben ciù piccin de quelli de l'imagine.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: I fotoin son ancon ciù piccin da röba chi compoñe i atomi!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Apreuvo de çentanæe de oe de fonçionamento, o fiamento da lampadiña in sciâ fin o se bruxa e a lampadiña a no fonçioña ciù.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Donca a lampadiña a dev'ëse sostituia. Beseugna dâ mente ben inta sostituçion da lampadiña.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Pe primma cösa, l'interruttô da lampa o dev'ëse asmòrto, ò o cavo descolligou.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Sto fæto perché l'elettriçitæ chi score inta preisa, donde s'attreuva a parte metallica da lampadiña, a peu dâ unna greive scòssa elettrica se se tocca o drento da preisa ò a base metallica da lampadiña, tanto ch'a l'é ancon parçialmente inta preisa.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: L'òrgano ciù gròsso do scistema çircolatöio o l'é o cheu, ch'o pompa o sangue.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: O sangue o va da-o cheu inte di cannæ, stæti acciammæ artëie, e o vëgne torna a-o cheu inte di cannæ stæti acciammæ veñe. I cannæ ciù piccin s'acciamman capilläi.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: I denti de un triceratopo saieivan stæti boin de scciancâ no solo e feugge ma fiña de ramme e de reixe belle rexistenti.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Diversci sciensiæ pensan che o triceratopo o mangesse e cicadee, che son un tipo de cianta commune into Cretaceo.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Ste ciante pan unna parma picciña con unna coroña de feugge appissue e affilæ.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Un triceratopo o l’aviæ posciuo deuviâ o seu fòrto becco pe streppâ e feugge avanti de mangiâ o teu.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Atri sciensiæ sostëgnan che ste ciante seggian ben ben velenose, donca l’é diffiçile che un dinosauro o ê mangesse, sciben che ancheu o bradipo e atre bestie comme o pappagallo (un discendente di dinosauri) peuan mangiâ de feugge ò di fruti velenoxi.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: In che mòddo a gravitæ de Io a m’attirieiva? Se ti te trovësci in sciâ superfiçie de Io, ti pesiësci de meno de quante no ti peisi in sciâ Tæra.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Unna persoña ch’a peisa 200 lie (90 chilli) in sciâ Tæra a pesieiva 36 lie circoncirca (16 chilli) in sce Io. Donca a gravitæ, se capisce, a t’attira de meno.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: O Sô o no gh’à unna crosta, comme a Tæra in sciâ quæ se ghe peu stâ. Tutto o sô o l’é fæto de gazzo, de feugo e de plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: O gazzo o se fa ciù fin de maniman che un o s’allontaña da-o centro do Sô.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: A parte esterna che veddemmo quande ammiemmo o Sô a l’é ciammâ fötosfera, che veu dî “balla de luxe”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Tremilla anni dòppo, circoncirca, do 1610, l’astrònomo italian Galielo Galilei o l’à deuviou un telescòpio pe osservâ che Venere a l’à de fase, pròpio comme a luña.
