text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Gh’é e fase perché solo o lato de Venere (ò da Luña) rivòlto verso o Sô o l’é inluminou. E fase de Venere supportavan a teoria de Copernico segondo a quæ i pianeti gian intorno a-o Sô.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Dapeu, quarche anno apreuvo, do 1639, un astrònomo ingleise ciammou Jeremiah Horrocks o l’à osservou un tranxito de Venere.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: L'Inghiltæra a l'aiva conosciuo un longo periodo de paxe dòppo a riconquista do Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Tutte e mainee, do 991 o Ethelred o s'ea scontrou con un steu vichingo ciù gròsso che quello do Guthrum un secolo avanti.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Sto steu o l'ea guiddou da-o Olaf Trygvasson, un Norveggin con l'ambiçion de riscattâ o seu paise da-a dominaçion daneise.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Dòppo di retardi militari a-o comenso, o Ethelred o l'à posciuo mettise d'accòrdio in scê condiçioin co-o Olaf, ch'o se n'é anæto torna in Norveggia à çercâ à guägnâse o seu regno con di exiti alterni.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: O hangeul o l’é l’unico arfabetto inventou de propòxito inte l’uso popolare cotidian. L’arfabetto o l’é stæto inventou do 1444, a-i tempi do regno de re Sejong (1418-1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: O re Sejong o l’ea o quarto da dinastia Joseon e o l’é un di ciù apprexæ.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: A-o prinçipio o l’à ciammou l’arfabetto “hengeul hunmin jeongeum”, ch’o veu dî “ i soin corretti pe l’instruçion do pòpolo”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Gh’e diverse teorie in sce comme segge nasciuo o sanscrito. Uña de queste a parla de unna migraçion di Ari da-o Ponente verso l’India, che avieivan portou con liatri a seu lengua.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: O sanscrito o l’é unna lengua antiga e a se peu paragonâ a-a lengua latiña parlâ in Euröpa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: O primmo libbro conosciuo a-o mondo o l’é stæto scrito in sanscrito. Dòppo a compilaçion de Upanishad, o sanscrito o l’é semplicemente spario, pe caxon da gerarchia.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: O sanscrito o l’é unna lengua assæ complessa e ricca, ch’a l’é servia comme vivagna pe tante lengue indiañe moderne, pròpio comme o latin o l’é a vivagna pe-e lengue europee, comme o franseise e o spagnòllo.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Stæto finio a battaggia contra a Fransa, a Germania a l’à comensou à prepararsi pe invadde l’isoa da Gran Bretagna.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: A Germania a gh’à dæto o nomme in còdice “Operaçion Lion de mâ”. A ciù parte de arme pesanti e di rifornimenti de l’esercito britannico ean anæti persci inte l’evacuaçion da Dunkerque, donca l’esercito l’ea ciutòsto debole.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ma a Royal Navy a l’ea ancon ben ben ciù fòrte da mariña tedesca (Kriegmarine”) e a l’aviæ posciuo destrue chesesegge flòtta de invaxon mandâ à traverso o Canâ da Manega.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Do resto, pochisime nave da Royal Navy ean basæ vexin a-e poscibili rotte de invaxon, stante che i ammiralli temmeivan che saieivan stæte affondæ da l’attacco aereo tedesco.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Comensemmo con unna spiegaçion in scî cien de l’Italia. L’Italia a l’ea ciù che atro o “fradellin” de Germania e Giappon.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: A l’aiva un esercito e unna mariña ciù deboli, sciben che a l’aveiva tòsto construio quattro nave neuve, giusto avanti de l’iniçio da guæra.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: I obbiettivi prinçipæ de l’Italia ean i paixi africhen. Pe piggiâ quelli paixi avieivan avuo beseugno de unna piattaforma de slanso de truppe, de mòddo che e truppe poessan navegâ à traverso o Mâ Mediterraneo e invadde l’Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pe questo an dovuo desbarassâse de base e de nave britanniche in Egitto. A-o de là de quelle açioin, e corassæ italiañe no avieivan dovuo fâ nint’atro.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Oua pe-o Giappon. O Giappon o l’ea un paise isoan, pròpio comme a Gran Bretagna.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: I sottomarin son de nave progettæ pe viægiâ sotta l’ægua e restâ lì pe un longo periodo de tempo.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: I sottomarin son stæti deuviæ inta primma e inta segonda guæra mondiale. Alantô ean assæ lenti e aveivan un raggio d’açion limitou.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: À l’iniçio da guæra viægiavan ciù che atro in superfiçie, ma quande radar o l’à comensou à sviluppâse e à vegnî ciù accurou son stæti constreiti à anâ sotta l’ægua pe evitâ de ëse visti.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: I sottomarin tedeschi ean ciammæ “U-Boat”. I tedeschi ean assæ bravi à navegâ e à deuviâ i seu sottomarin.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Pe caxon do seu successo co-i sottomarin, dòppo a guæra no se credde che i tedeschi n’aggian ancon guæi.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Scì! O Re Tutankhamon, indicou de vòtte co-o nomme de “Re Tut” ò “O Re Figgeu”, o l’é un di re egiçi antighi tra i ciù conosciui inti tempi moderni.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: L’é interessante nottâ che o no l’ea consciderou guæi importante inti tempi antighi e o no l’ea registrou inta ciù parte de liste antighe di re.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Con tutto, a scoverta da seu tomba, do 1922, a l’à reiso unna celebritæ. Mentre ben ben de tombe son stæte arröbæ, sta tomba chì a l’é restâ praticamente indisturbâ.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: A ciù parte di oggetti sotterræ con Tutankhamon son stæti conservæ ben, incluso miggiæa de ògetti realizzæ con metalli preçioxi e prie rare.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: L’invençion de reue à raggi a l’à reiso i cari asciri ciù legi, ciù veloci e megio preparæ à superâ i sordatti e i atri cari.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: E fresse de seu micidiali balestre porrieivan penetrâ l’armatua di sordatti rivali. Intorno a-o 1000 a.C. i Asciri an introduto a primma cavalleria.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Unna cavalleria a l’é un esercito ch’o combatte à cavallo. A sella a no l’ea stæta ancon inventâ, donca a cavalleria ascira a combatteiva in scî dòrsci nui di seu cavalli.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Conoscemmo tanti politichi, sciensiæ e artisti greghi. Fòscia o personaggio o ciù avvoxou de sta coltua o l’é Omero, o lezzendäio poeta òrbo, che o l’à compòsto doî cappolavori da lettiatua grega: l’Iliade e l’Odissea.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sòfocle e Aristòfane son ancon di drammaturghi avvoxæ e e seu euvie son tegnue tra e ciù grende euvie da lettiatua mondiale.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Un atro grego famoso o l’é un matematico, Pitagora, conosciuo sorviatutto pe-o seu avvoxou teorema in scê relaçioin di lati di triangoli rettangoli.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Gh’é varie stimme in sce quante persoñe parlan hindi. Se stimma che a segge tra a segonda e a quarta lengua ciù parlâ a-o mondo.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: O numero de persoñe de lengua moæ o cangia à segonda che se conte ò meno i dialetti ciù vexin.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: E stimme varian da 340 mioin à 500 mioin de parlanti e scin à 800 mioin de persoñe che peuan accapî a lengua.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi e Urdu son scimili into vocaboläio, ma despægi inta scrittua; inte conversaçioin cotidiañe, i parlanti de doe lengue pe-o sòlito peuan capîse.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Intorno a-o secolo XV l’Estònia do settentrion a l’ea sotta unna grande influensa colturale da Germania.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Di moneghi tedeschi an vosciuo avvixinâ quelli do pòsto à Dio, donca an inventou a lengua estone letteräia.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: A l’ea basâ in sce l’arfabetto tedesco e o l’é stæto azzonto un carattere: “Õ/õ”.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Co-o passâ do tempo tante paròlle piggiæ in prestito da-o tedesco se son unie. Sto chì o l’é stæto l’iniçio de l’inluminaçion.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Segondo a tradiçion l’erede a-o tröno o saieiva anæto direttamente inte l’esercito, dapeu d’avei terminou a scheua.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Do resto, Carlo o l’é anæto à l’Universcitæ a-o Trinity College de Cambridge, donde o l’à studiou antropologia e arheologia, e dapeu stöia, ottegnindo un 2:2 (un diplöma inferiô de segonda classe).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Carlo o l’é stæto o primmo membro da famiggia reale britannica à ottegnî unna laurea.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: A Turchia europea (Tracia orientale ò Rumelia, inta penisoa barcanica) a compende o 3% do paise.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: O territöio da Turchia o l’é longo ciù de 1600 chillòmetri (1.000 mi) e largo 800 km (500 mi), con unna forma ciù ni meno rettangolare.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: A superficce da Turchia, compreiso i laghi, a l’òccupa 783.562 chillòmetri quaddri (300.948 mi²), di quæ 755.688 chillòmetri quaddri (291.773 mi²) se treuvan into sud-òvest de l’Asia e 23.764 chillòmetri quaddri (9.174 mi²) in Euröpa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: A superfiçie da Turchia a â rende o 37n paise ciù grande do mondo e a mesua ciù ni meno comme a Fransa metropolitaña o Regno Unio missi insemme.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: A Turchia a l’é circondâ da-o mâ in sce trei lati: o Mâ Egeo à Ponente, o Mâ Neigro à nòrd e o Mâ Mediterraneo à sud.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: O Lussemburgo o l’à unna stöia antiga, ma a seu indipendensa a remonta solo che a-o 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: De zöne che in giornâ forman parte do Belgio un tempo favan parte do Lussemburgo, ma son vegnue belghe apreuvo a-a revoluçion belga di anni ’30 de l’Euttoçento.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: O Lussemburgo o l’à delongo çercou de restâ un paise neutrale, ma o l’é stæto occupou da-a Germania segge inta primma che inta segonda guæra mondiale.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Do 1957 o Lussemburgo o l’é vegnuo membro fondatô de l’organizzaçion che ancheu a l’é conosciua comme Union Europea.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: O Drukgyal Dzong o l’é unna fortessa in roiña e un monastê buddista inta parte de d’ato de Paro (into paise de Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Dixe che do 1649 Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel o l’à construio a fortessa pe commemorâ a seu vittöia contra e fòrse tibeten-mongole.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Do 1951 un incendio o l’à fæto scì che restesse solo quarche relichia do Drukgyal Dzong, comme l’imagine de Zhabdrung Ngawang.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Apreuvo à l’incendio a fortessa a l’é stæta avvardâ e protetta, con restâ uña de attraçioin ciù spettacolari do Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: A Cambòggia do secolo XVIII a s’é trovâ streita tra doî vexin potenti, Thailandia e Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: I thailandeixi an invaso a Cambòggia diverse vòtte do secolo XVIII, e do 1772 an destruto Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Inti urtimi anni do secolo XVIII i vietnamiti ascì an invaso a Cambòggia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: O 18% di venessuelen o l’é desoccupou e a ciù parte de quelli che son occupæ travaggian inte l’economia informale.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Doî tersci di venessuelen che travaggian ô fan into settô di serviçi, squæxi un terso inte l’industria e un quinto inte l’agricoltua.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Unn’industria importante pe-i venessuelen a l’é o petròlio, do quæ o paise o l’é esportatô netto, sciben che solo l’un in sce çento o travaggia inte l’industria petrolifera.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: A-o pinçipio de l’indipendensa da naçion, l’esperiensa di giardin botanichi de Scingapô a l’à contribuio à transformâ l’isoa inte un girardin tropocale.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Do 1981 Vanda Miss Joaquim, un ibrido de orchidee, o l’é stæto çernuo comme a scioa naçionale da naçion.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Tutti i anni verso ötobre squæxi 1,5 mioin de erbivoi viægian da-e colliñe do settentrion in direçion de cianue do meridion, pe mezo do sciumme Mara, pe-a saxon de ægue.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E dapeu torna à nòrd, passando pe-o ponente, atraversando torna o sciumme Mara, dòppo e ægue, verso arvî.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: A region do Serengeti a contëgne o Parco Naçionâ do Serengeti, l’Aria de Conservaçion de Ngorongoro e a Riserva de Maswa, in Tansania, e a Riserva Naçionâ de Masai Mara, in Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Imprende à creâ di media interattivi o domanda de competense convençionali e tradiçionæ, ma ascì di instrumenti che s’imprendan inte classe intersattive (storyboard, editing audio e video, storytelling, ecc.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: A progettaçion interattiva a domanda de rivalutâ e teu ipòtexi in sciâ produçion di media e de imprende à pensâ inte un mòddo no liniare.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: A progettaçion interattiva a domanda che i componenti de un progetto seggian connesci tra de liatri, ma che aggian anche senso comme entitæ separæ.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: O desvantaggio di obiettivi zoom o l’é che a compescitæ di feughi e o numero di elementi de l’obiettivo neçessäi pe ottegnî unna çerta gamma de longhesse de feugo a l’é ben ben de ciù à peto di obiettivi a feugo fisso.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Sto chì o l’é apreuvo à vegnî meno problematico perché i produttoî de obiettivi razzonzan di standard ciù elevæ inta produçion di obiettivi.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Sto chì o l’à permisso a-i obiettivi zoom de produe de imagine de qualitæ paragonabile à quella ottegnua da obiettivi con longhixe de feugo fissa.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Un atro desvantaggio di obiettivi zoom o l’é che l’avertua mascima (a velocitæ) de l’obiettivo a l’é pe sòlito inferiô.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Sto chì o rende diffiçile l’uso de obiettivi zoom à bon patto, in condiçioin de pöca inlumanaçion e sensa flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un di problemi ciù commuin quande se çerca à convertî un cine into formou DVD o l'é l'overscan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: E ciù tante televixoin son fæte in mòddo da contentâ o pubrico generale.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Pe quella raxon, tutto quello che ti veddi in sciâ TV o l'aiva i bòrdi taggiæ, de d'ato, de sotta e de lato.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Sto chì o ven fæto pe asseguâse che l'imagine a creuve o schermo intrego. Ch'o l'é ciammou overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Pe sfortuña, quande ti fæ un DVD, l'é façile che i bòrdi de l'imagine ascì sciòrtan taggiæ, e se o video o l'aiva di sottotitoli tròppo vexin a-o fondo, no se porrian vedde ben.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: O tradiçionale castello de l'etæ de mezo o l'à de longo inspirou l'imaginaçion, con reciammâ imagine de tornei, festin e cavallaia arturiaña.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Fiña de stâ in pê tra de roiñe vegie de miggiæa de anni, l'é façile fâse vegnî in cheu i soin e i ödoî de battagge passæ da tempo, e tòsto sentî o sciato di seuccai in scî risseu e annastâ a poia ch'a monta da-i possi de prexoin.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ma a nòstra imaginaçion a l'é fondâ in sciâ realitæ? Perché gh'ea di castelli construti avanti de tutto? Comme vegnivan progettæ e construti?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tipico do periodo, o castello de Kirby Muxleo a l’é ciù unna casa fortificâ che un veo e pròpio castello.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: E seu grendi vedrate e e seu miage sottî no avieivan rexistio à longo à un attacco deciso.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Inti anni ‘80 do Quattroçento, quande a seu construçion a l’é stæta inandiâ da Lord Hastings, o paise o l’ea relativamento pacifico e a difeisa a l’ea neçessäia solo che contra de bande picciñe de predoin erranti.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: L’equilibrio de poei o l’ea un scistema into quæ e naçioin europee çercavan de mantegnî a sovranitæ naçionale de tutti i Stati europëi.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: O concetto o l’ea che tutte e naçioin doveivan çercâ de impedî à unna naçion de vegnî potente, e donca i governi naçionæ de spesso cangiavan e seu alleanse pe mantegnî l’equilibrio.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: A Guæra de Succescion Spagnòlla a l’é stæta a primma guæra donde a costion primmäia a l’ea l’equilibrio de poei.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Questo o l’à scignificou un cangio importante, perché e potense europee no avieivan ciù avuo l’attesto de guære de reiligion. Coscì, a Guæra di Trent’anni a saieiva stæta l’urtima guæra à ëse etichettâ comme guæra de religion.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: O tempio de Artemide à Efeso o l’é stæto destruto a-i 21 de luggio do 356 s.C. inte un incendio appiccou à pòsta da Eròstrato.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Segondo a stöia a motivaçion a l’ea a famma à tutti i costi. I efexin, indignæ, annonçian che o nomme de Eròstrato o no saiæ mai stæto regordou.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: O stòrico grego Strabon o n’annòtta o dapeu o nomme, comme ô conoscemmo ancheu. O tempio o l’é stæto destruto a mæxima neutte inta quæ l’é nasciuo Lusciandro Magno.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Lusciandro, comme re, o se òffre de pagâ pe construe torna o tempio, ma a seu offerta a vëgne refuâ. Dapeu, apreuvo a-a mòrte do Lusciandro, o tempio o l’é stæto construio torna do 323 a.C.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Asseguite che a teu man a segge o ciù poscibile rilassâ, tanto che ti contiunui à sunnâ correttamente tutte e nòtte – çerca ascì de no fâ tanti movimenti superflui co-e die.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Inte sto mòddo ti te stanchiæ o meno poscibile. Regòrda che no l’é neçessäio sciaccâ i tasti con tanta fòrsa pe aumentâ o volumme, comme in sciô pianofòrte.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: In sciâ fisa, pe ottegnî o volumme extra, deuvia o mantexo con ciù prescion ò velocitæ.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: O mistiçiximo o l’é a reçerca da communion, de l’identitæ ò da consapevolessa consciente de unna realtæ urtima, unna divinitæ, unna veritæ spirituale ò Dio.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: O creddente o çerca unn’esperiensa diretta, unn’instituçion ò unna vixon profonda da realtæ diviña/da divinitæ ò de divinitæ.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: I seguaci van apreuvo à çerti mòddi de vive ò pratiche che an l’intendimento de alimentâ quelle esperiense.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: O mistiçiximo o peu ëse distinto da atre forme de creddensa e adoraçion religiosa pe-a seu enfaxi in sce l’esperiensa diretta de un stato de consciensa unico, mascime quelli de carattere pacifico, intelligente, biou ò fiña estatico.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: O sikhismo a l’é unna religion do subcontinente indian. A l’à avuo origine inta region do Punjab into secolo XV da unna divixon settäia à l’interno da tradiçion indù.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: O sikh conscideran a seu fede unna religion separâ da l’induismo, sciben che ne riconoscian e reixe e e tradiçioin indù.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: I sikh ciamman a seu religion Gurmat, che in punjabi veu dî “via do guru”. O guru o l’é un aspetto primmäio de tutte e religioin, ma into sikhismo o l’à piggiou unn’importansa che a constituisce o cheu de creddense sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: A religion a l’é stæta inandiâ do secolo XV da Guru Nanak (1469-1539). Gh’é vegnuo apreuvo, in succescion, atri neuve guru.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: À tutti i mòddi, do zugno 1956, e promisse de Krusciòv son stæte misse à dua preuva quande e rivòlte in Polònia, donde i lavoratoî protestavan contra a farta de çibbo e i taggi a-i saläi, se transforman inte unna protesta generale contra o communismo.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Sciben che in sciâ fin o Krusciòv o l’à mandou i cari armæ pe ristabilî l’ordine, o l’à ceduo à çerte richieste econòmiche e o l’à accettou de nominâ o popolare Wladyslaw Gomulka comme neuvo primmo ministro.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: A civiltæ da valle de l’Indo a l’ea unna civiltæ de l’etæ do bronzo do subcontinente indian nòrd-occidentale, ch’a comprendeiva a ciù parte do moderno Pakistan e çerte regioin de l’India nòrd-occidentale e de l’Afghanistan nòrd-orientale.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: A civiltæ a l’é scioia inti baçî do sciumme Indo, da-o quæ a piggia o seu nomme.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Sceiben che çerti studioxi ipotizzan che, stante che a civiltæ a l’existiva anche inti baçî do sciumme Sarasvati, ormai sciuto, dovieiva vegnî ciammâ ciù propiamente civiltæ de l’Indo-Sarasvati, mentre çertidun â ciamman civiltæ Harappa, da Harappa, o primmo di seu sciti à ëse cavou inti anni ‘20.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: A natua militaristica de l’impero romano a l’à aggiuttou into sviluppo di progresci da mëxiña.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: I meghi an comensou à ëse reclutæ da l’imperatô Augusto e an formou o primmo còrpo romano de meghi da deuviâ à l’indoman de battagge.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: I chirurghi ean à conoscensa de diversci sedativi tra i quæ a morfiña, estræta da di semmi de papaveo e a scopolamiña, da di semmi de erba.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Son vegnui asperti inte l’amputaçion pe sarvâ i paçienti da-a cancrena, coscì comme di lassi emostatichi e de pinse arteriose, pe arginâ o flusso do sangue.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Into corso de diversci secoli, l’Impero Romano o l’à portou à grendi conquiste into campo da mëxiña e o l’à formou gran parte da conoscensa che conoscemmo ancheu.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: L’origami Pureland o l’é un origami co-a restriçion che peu ëse eseguio solo che unna ceiga pe vòtta, no l’é consentio de ceighe ciù complesse, comme e ceighe imböse, e tutte e ceighe an de poxiçioin semplici.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: L’é stæto sviluppo da John Smith inti anni ’70 pe aggiuttâ di cegatoî meno asperti ò con de capaçitæ motöie limitæ.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: I figgeu sviluppan unna consapevolessa da razza e di stereòtipi razziali ciutòsto da zoeni, e sti stereòtipi razziali influensan o comportamento.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Pe exempio i figgeu che s’identifican con unna minoransa razziale stereotipâ comme s’a no l’anesse ben à scheua, tendan à no anâ ben à scheua, unna vòtta impreiso o stereòtipo assoçiou a-a seu razza.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace o l'é o terso scito web ciù popolare tra quelli deuviæ inti Stati Unii e o gh'à 54 mioin di profî inte sto momento.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Sti sciti web an ottegnuo un muggio d'attençion, mascime into campo de l'educaçion.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Gh'é di aspeti poxitivi de sti sciti web, che includdan, ëse boin da mette sciù de lengê unna pagina de classe ch'a peu includde blog, video, föto, e atre fonçionalitæ.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Sta pagina a l'é de bon intrâghe con fornî solo che un adresso web, ch'o se pòsse tegnî à mente de lengê e o segge de bon scrive pe studenti che peuan avei de difficortæ à deuviâ a tastea ò à accompâ.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: O peu ëse personalizzou pe rendilo ciù de bon leze e ascì con tanto ò pöco cô comme se veu.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: O disturbo da deficit de attençion “a l’é un scindrome neurològica definia clascicamente da unna triade de scintomi tra i quæ impulscivitæ, distraibilitæ e iperattivitæ ò energia in eccesso”.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: A no l’é unn’incapaçitæ de imprendimento, o l’é un disturbo de l’impendimento; o “corpisce da-o 3 a-o 5% de tutti i figgeu, fòscia fiña 2 mioin de figgeu americhen”.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: I figgeu con ADD an difficoltæ à concentrâse in sce de cöse comme o travaggio scolastico, ma peuan concentrâse in sce de cöse che gh’é cao fâ comme zugâ ò ammiâ i seu cartoin preferii, ò scrive de frase sensa pontezzatua.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Sti figgeu tendan à cacciâse inte un muggio de ciæti, perché “piggian di comportamenti reisegoxi, rattellan e sfiddan l’autoritæ” pe stimolâ o seu çervello, stante che o seu çervello o no peu ëse stimolou con di metodi normali.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: L’ADD a l’influisce in scê relaçioin co-i atri da mæxima etæ perché i atri figgeu no riescian à capî perché se compòrtan inte quello mòddo ò perché scrivan coscì comme fan, ò perché o seu livello de maturitæ o l’é despægio.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Scicomme a capaçitæ de ottegnî de conoscense e de imprense a l’é cangiâ mai tanto, comme tòsto accennou, l’é cangiou a velocitæ de base co-a quæ se ottëgne a conoscensa.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: O metodo pe ottegnî de informaçioin o l’ea despægio. A prescion a no l’ea ciù drento a-o regòrdo individuale, ma a capaçitæ d’arregordâ a vegniva o focus.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: In sostansa a Renascion a l’à portou un cangiamento scignificativo into metodo de impredimento e inta diffuxon de conoscensa.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: À differensa de atre scimie, i omminidi no deuvian ciù e moen inta locomoçion, pe sostegnî o peiso ò pe locciâ tra i erboi.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: A man e o pê di scimpansé son scimili pe dimenscioin e longhixe, con riflette l’uso da man pe sostegnî o peiso into camminâ in scî zonchetti.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: A man umaña a l’é ciù curta do pê, con de falangi ciù drite.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: De òsse fòscili de doî ò trei mioin de anni rivelan questo cangiamento inta specializzaçion da man, da-a locomoçion a-a manipolaçion.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Çerte persoñe creddan che sperimentâ ciutòsto de soventi di seunni lucidi induti artifiçialmente o pòsse ëse assæ estenuante.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: A raxon prinçipâ de sto fenòmeno o l’é o resultato de di seunni lucidi che espandan o periodo de tempo tra i stati REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Con un numero minô de REM pe neutte, sto stato into quæ se fa esperiensa do seunno effettivo e o còrpo o se repiggia o vëgne assæ raro, tanto da vegnî un problema.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Questo o l’é tanto estenuante comme se ti t’addescësci ògni vinti ò trenta menuti e ti ammiësci a TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: L’effetto o dipende da-a frequensa co-a quæ o teu çervello o tenta de assunnâse lucidamente ògni neutte.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: E cöse no anavan ben pe-i italien into Nord Africa asquæxi da-o comenso. Unna settemaña da-a diciaraçion de guæra de l'Italia di 10 de zugno 1940, l'11° di Ussai Britannico o l'aiva piggiou Forte Capuzzo in Libia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Inte unn'imboscâ à Levante de Bardia, i Britannichi an catturou o generale italian Lastucci, cappo do Genio da Dexima Armâ
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: A-i 28 de zugno, o maresciallo Italo Balbo, Governatô Generale da Libia e erede designou do Mussolini, o vegniva ammassou da feugo amigo, tanto ch'o l'atterrava à Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: O spòrt moderno da scherma o l’é pratticou à diversci livelli, da-i studenti che imparan inte unn’universcitæ a-e competiçioin profescionistiche e olimpiche.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: O spòrt o se prattica inte un formou de duello, uno schermitô ch’o duella con un atro.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: O gòlf o l’é un zeugo into quæ i zugoei deuvian de masse pe sponciâ de ballette inte cille.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Dixeutto cille vëgnan zugæ inte un gio regolare, co-i zugoei che pe sòlito comensan da-a primma cilla do campo e finiscian a-a dixeutteña.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Guägna o zugou ch’o ghe mette meno corpi, o swing da massa, pe completâ o percorso.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: O zeugo o se zeuga in sce l’erba, e l’erba intorno a-a cilla a vëgne segâ ciù curta e a vëgne ciammâ green.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Fòscia o tipo o ciù commune de turismo o l’é quello che a ciù parte de persoñe a l’assòcia a-i viægi: turismo ricreativo.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Questo succede quande e persoñe van inte un pòsto che o l’é assæ differente da-a seu vitta normale, pe rilassâse e demoâse.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: E spiage, i parchi e i campeggi son de spesso i pòsti ciù frequentæ da-i turisti ricreativi.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Se l’obiettivo da vixita de un determinou pòsto o l’é conoscine a stöia e a coltua, aloa sto tipo de turismo o vëgne conosciuo comme turismo colturale.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: I turisti peuan vixitâ diversci paraggi de un çerto paise ò peuan semplicemente çerne de concentrâse in sce unna sola area.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Anche i colöni, veddendo st’attivitæ, aivan domandou di rinfòrsci.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: E truppe che rinforsavan e poxiçioin avansæ includdeivan o I e o III reggimento da 200 òmmi do New Hamposhire, a-o commando di colonnelli John Stark e James Reed (tutti doî, apreuvo, son dicentæ generali).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: I òmmi de Stark piggian poxiçion longo a-o recinto à l’estremitæ nòrd da poxiçion di colöni.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Quande a bassa marea a l’à averto un varco longo o sciumme Mystic longo o nòrd-est da penisoa, an esteiso fito o recinto con unna miagia curta de pria à nòrd, ch’a finisce in sciô bòrdo de l’ægua in sce unna spiagia picciña.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley ò Stark an poxiçionou un paletto à circa 100 pê (30 m) davanti a-o recinto e an ordinou che nisciun sparesse scin à quande i regolari no l’avessan superou.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: O cian american o se basava in sciô slanso de di attacchi cordinæ da træ diverse direçioin.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: O generale John Cadwalder o l’aviæ asbriou un attacco diverscivo contra a guarnixon britannica à Berdentown, con l’intendimento de bloccâ di eventuali rinfòrsci.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: O generale James Ewing o l’aviæ portou 700 miliçie à traverso o sciumme à Trenton Ferry, o l’aviæ piggiou o ponto in sce l’Assunpink Creek, e impedio a-e truppe nemighe de scappâ.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: A prinçipâ fòrsa d’assato de 2.400 òmmi a l’aviæ attraversou o sciumme neuve miggia à nòrd de Trenton, e dapeu a se saieiva spartia inte doî gruppi, un sotta Green e un sotta Sullivan, pe asbriâ un attacco avanti de l’arba.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Co-o passaggio da-o quarto de miggio a-a corsa de mezo miggio, a veloçitæ a vëgne ben ben meno importante e a rexistensa a vëgne unna neçescitæ assolua.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Se capisce che un euttoçentometrista de primma classe, un òmmo che peu anâ sotta i doî menuti, o deve possede unna çerta velocitæ, ma a rexistensa a dev’ëse coltivâ à tutti i costi.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Un pittin de corsa campestre inte l’inverno, unia a-o travaggio in palestra pe-a parte superiô do còrpo, a l’é a megio preparaçion pe-a stagion da corsa.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: E corrette prattiche de alimentaçion da sole no peuan generâ de prestaçioin d’élite, però peuan influiî in mòddo scignificativo in sciô bestâ generale di zoveni atleti.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mantegnî un equilibrio energetico san, pratticâ de abitudini de idrataçion efficaci e comprende i diversci aspeti de prattiche de integraçion peu aggiuttâ i atleti à megioâ e seu prestaçioin e aumentâ o divertimento into spòrt.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: A corsa in sciâ media distansa o l’é un spòrt relativamente pöco costoso; con tutto, gh’é un muggio de idee erræ riguardo i pöchi pessi de equipaggiamento neçessäi pe parteçipâ.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: I produti peuan ëse accattæ segondo a neçescitæ, ma a ciù parte o l’avià un impatto minimo ò pesso in scê prestaçioin.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: I atleti peuan retegnî de preferî un produto anche quande o no fornisce di benefiçi reali.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L’atomo o peu ëse consciderou un di elementi constitutivi primmäi da materia.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: O l’é unn’entitæ complessa ch’a consciste, segondo un modello de Bohr semplificou, de un nucleo centrale in òrbita intorno a-i elettroin, in quarche mòddo scimile a-i pianeti in òrbita intorno a-o sô – s’ammie a Figua 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: O nucleo o l’é constituio da doe particelle: neutroin e protoin.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: I protoin an unna carrega elettrica poxitiva tanto che i neutroin no an de carrega. I elettroin incangio an unna carrega elettrica negativa.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Pe controllâ a vittima, ti devi primma ispeçionâ a scena pe garantî a teu seguessa.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Ti devi nottâ a poxiçion da vittima tanto che ti t’avvixiñi à lê, e e eventuali bandee automatiche rosse.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Se ti te fæ mâ çercando de aggiuttâ, ti porriësci solo servî à pezoâ e cöse.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: O studio o l’à scoverto che a deprescion, a poia e o catastrofismo median a relaçion tra dolô e disabilitæ inte chi o sòffre de lombalgia.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Solo i effetti da castrofizzaçion, no a deprescion ò a poia, ean condiçionæ da de regolari sescioin strutturæ e settimanali de PA.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Quelli che fan unn’attivitæ regolare an domandou ciù tanto arrembo in termini de perceçion negativa do mâ, con distingue e differense tra o mâ e o disagio percepio da-o normale movimento fixico.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: A vista, ò a capaçitæ de vedde, a dipende da-i òrgani sensoriali do scistema vixivo, ò euggi.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Gh’é tante construçioin de euggi despæge, che varian in complescitæ à segonda de exigense de l’organismo.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: E tante construçioin an capacitæ diverse, son senscibili à longhesse d’onda despæge e an varri graddi d’intenscitæ, pe de ciù an beseugno de unn’elaboraçion despægia pe dâ un senso à l’input e numeri despægi pe fonçionâ in mòddo milia.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Unna popolaçion a l’é unna serie de organismi de unna particolare specie à l’interno de unna çerta area geografica.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Quande tutti i individui inte unna popolaçion son pægi pe quante riguarda un çerto tratto fenotipico, se ghe dixe monomòrfi.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Quande i individui mostran diverse varianti de un çerto tratto son polimòrfichi.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Anche e colònie de formigoe de l’esercito marcian e fan i nii inte varie fase.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Inta fase nòmade e formigoe marcian de neutte e se ferman à accampâse de giorno.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: A colònia a comensa unna fase nòmade quand’o çibbo disponibile o l’é ammermou. Inte sta fase a colònia a realizza di nii temporanei che vëgnan cangiæ tutti i giorni.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Ougniduña de ste furie ò marce nòmadi a dua circa 17 giorni.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Cöse l’é unna çellola? A paròlla çellola a deriva da-o latin “cella” che veu dî “stançieta”, e a l’é stæta coniâ pe-a primma vòtta da un microscopista ch’o l’osservava a struttua da natta.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: A çellola a l’é l’unitæ de base de tutti i ësi viventi e tutti i organismi son compòsti da unna ò ciù çellole.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: E çellole, de fæti, son mai tanto primmäie e fondamentali pe-o sviluppo da vitta, che de spesso son indicæ comme “i moin da vitta”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: O scistema nervoso o matëgne l’omeostaxi con mandâ di impulsci nervoxi à traverso o còrpo pe mantegnî ininterrotto o flusso do sangue.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Sti impulsci nervoxi peuan ëse mandæ mai tanto rapidamente inte tutto o còrpo, cösa ch’a l’aggiutta o còrpo à mantegnîse a-o seguo da chesesegge potençiale menassa.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: I tornado corpiscian unn’aria picciña à peto de atre violente tempeste, ma peuan destrue tutto in sciô seu cammin.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: I tornado arrancan i erboi, streppan e asse di casamenti e caccian e machine in çê. O doî in sce çento o ciù violento o dua ciù de træ oe.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Ste tempeste monstruose an di venti scin à 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: I ësi umoen produxan e deuvian de lente pe l’ingrandimento da miggiæa e miggiæa de anni.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Con tutto, i primmi vëi telescòpi son stæti realizzæ in Euröpa a-a fin do secolo XVI.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Sti telescòpi deuviavan unna combinaçion de doe lente pe fâ apparî i oggetti distanti segge ciù vexin segge ciù grendi.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: L’avditæ e l’egoismo saian delongo con niatri e l’é inta natua da coperaçion che quande a maggioransa a gh’aivà di vantaggi, ghe saià sempre da guägnâ de ciù, in sciô curto, con agî egoisticamente.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Se spera che a ciù parte de persoñe a se rende conto che a megio opçion in sciô lungo termine a l’é travaggiâ insemme a-i atri.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Tante persoñe s’asseunnan o giorno into quæ i umeon porrian viægiâ verso unn’atra stella e esplorâ di atri mondi, çerti se domandan cöse ghe segge lì feua, quarchidun o credde che di alieni ò de atre forme de vitta pòssan vive in sce un atro pianeta.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Ma se sto chì o dovesse mai intravegnî, l’é façile ch’o no l’intravegnià pe guæi tempo. E stelle son mai tanto spantegæ che gh’é de miggiæa de miliardi de miggia tra e stelle ch’en “vexiñe”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Fòscia un giorno i teu pronevi saian in çimma à un mondo alieno domandandose di antighi antenæ?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: I animæ son fæti de tante çellole. Mangian e cöse e ê digeriscian drento. A ciù parte di animæ a peu mesciâse.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Solo i animæ an o çervello (sciben che no tutti i animæ ghe l’an; e carnasse, pe exempio, no an de çervello).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: I animæ se treuvan in sce tutta a tæra. Scavan into terren, neuan inti oçeani e xeuan into çê.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Unna çellola a l’é a ciù picciña unitæ struttuale e fonçionale de un organismo vivente.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Çellola a vëgne da-a paròlla latiña cella ch’a veu dî stançia picciña.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Se ti ammii i ësi viventi a-o microscòpio, ti veddiæ che son fæti da quaddri piccin ò da ballette.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, un biòlogo ingleise, o l’à visto a-o microscòpio di quaddretti de natta.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Paivan de stançie. O l’é stæto a primma persoña à osservâ de çellole mòrte
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: I elementi e i compòsti peuan mesciâse da un stato à l’atro e no cangiâ.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: L’azöto comme gazzo o l’à ancon e mæxime propietæ de l’azöto liquido. O stato liquido o l’é ciù denso, ma e molecole son sempre e mæxime.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: L’ægua a l’é un atro exempio. L’ægua compòsta a l’é fæta da doî atomi de idrògeno e un atomo de ossigeno.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: A l’à a mæxima struttua molecolare segge che se tratte de un gazzo, de un liquido ò de un sòlido.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Sciben che o seu stato fixico o peu cangiâ, o seu stato chimico o l’arresta o mæximo.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: O tempo o l’é quarcösa che o l’é tutto in gio à niatri e o l’influensa tutto quello che femmo, ma l’é diffiçile capî.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: O tempo o l’é stæto studiou pe miggiæa de anni da-i studioxi, i filòsofi e i sciensiæ.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Vivemmo o tempo comme unna serie de eventi che passan da-o futuo à traverso o presente verso o passou.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: O tempo l’é ascì o mòddo into quæ confrontemmo a duâ (longhixe) di eventi.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Ti peu segnâ ti mæximo o passâ do tempo con osservâ o ripetise de un evento ciclico. Un evento ciclico o l’é quarcösa ch’o se ripete regolarmente.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: I computer son deuviæ ancheu pe manipolâ e imagine e i video.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: De animaçioin sofisticæ peuan ëse construie in scî computer e questo tipo de animaçion o vëgne sempre ciù deuviou in televixon e inte pellicole.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: A muxica a vëgne registrâ de spesso deuviando o computer pe elaborâ e micsâ i soin insemme.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Pe tanto tempo, into secolo XIX e into XXI, s’é credduo che i primmi abitanti da Neuva Zelanda fïsan o pòpolo maöri, ch’o cacciava di öxelli zaganti ciammæ möa.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: A teoria a l’à donca stabilio che o pòpolo maöri o segge emigrou con un Grande Steu e o l’agge piggiou a Neuva Zelanda da-i moriöri, inandiando unna soçietæ agricola.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Do resto, de neuve preuve suggeriscian che i moriöri fïsan un gruppo de maöri da tæraferma che son emigræ da-a Neuva Zelanda a-e isoe Chatham, sviluppando a seu coltua distinta e paçifica.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Gh’ea ascì unn’atra tribù in scê isoe Chatham, sti chì ean maöri che son emigreæ da-a Neuva Zelanda.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Se ciammavan à liatri mæximi mariöri, gh’é stæto di ciæti e in sciâ fin i moriöri son stæti scorrii
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: E persoñe che ean stæte coinvòlte pe diversci dexenni n’an aggiuttou à apprexâ i nòstri ponti de fòrsa e e nòstre pascioin, tanto che valutavimo tranquillamente e difficoltæ e fiña i fallimenti.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Con dâ a mente a-e persoñe che scompartiscian e seu stöie individuali, de famiggia e de organizzaçion, emmo ottegnuo de informaçioin preçiose in sciô passou e in scê çerte personalitæ che an influensou a coltua de l’organizzaçion, into ben ò into mâ.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Tanto che a comprension da stöia de un a no presuppoñe a comprenscion da coltua, a l’aggiutta a-o manco e persoñe à capî donde cazzan à l’interno da stöia de l’organizzaçion.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Tanto che valutan i succesci e piggian consciensa di fallimenti, i individui e l’insemme de persoñe parteçipanti screuvan ciù profondamente i valoî, a miscion e e fòrse trainanti de l’organizzaçion.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Inte sto caxo, regordâ i comportamenti imprenditoriali precedenti e i resultati che no son derivæ o l’à aggiuttou e persoñe à ëse averte à di neuvi cangiamenti e à neuve direçioin pe-a Gexa locale.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: De stöie de successo coscì fæte an ammermou e poie do cangiamento, con creâ a-o mæximo tempo de inclinaçioin poxitive verso o cangiamento in futuo.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: I modelli de pensceo convergente en de tecniche pe risòlve e difficortæ che uniscian idee ò campi despægi pe trovâ unna soluçion.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: O ponto de st'atteggiamento mentale o l'é a lestixe, a lògica e a preçixon, l'identificaçion di fæti ascì, e neuve applicaçioin de tecniche che existan za, e l'ottegnimento de informaçioin.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: O fattô ciù importante de sto atteggiamento mentale o l'é: gh'é solo che unna respòsta giusta. Ti pensi solo che doe respòste, segge à dî giusta ò sbaliâ.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Sta meña de pensceo chì a l'é assoçiâ con unna çerta sciensa ò procedua standard.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: E gente con sta smersa de pensceo chì gh'an un pensceo lògico, son boñe da mandâ à memöia di modelli, resciòrve di problemi e travaggiâ in sce di testi scientifichi
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: I ësi umoen son de brutto a specie con ciù talento pe leze e mente di atri.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Questo veu dî che semmo boin de prevedde con successo quello che atri umoen perçepiscian, intendan, creddan, conoscian ò dexideran.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Tra queste abilitæ, a comprenscion de intençioin di atri a l’é cruçiale. A ne permette de risòlve de ambiguitæ de açioin fixiche.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Pe exempio, se ti doviësci vedde quarchidun ch’o rompe o barconetto de unna machina, probabilmente ti pensciësci che o l’é apreuvo à çercâ de arröbâ a machina de un estraneo.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: O l’aviæ beseugno de ëse giudicou in mòddo despægio se o l’avesse perso e ciave damachina, e l’ea inta seu stessa machina ch’o stava çercando de intrâ.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: A risonsansa magnetica a se basa in sce un fenòmeno fixico ciammou risonsansa magnetica nucleare (NMR), scoverto inti anni ’30 da Felix Bloch (ch’o travaggiava a-a Stanford University) e Edward Purcell (de l’Universcitæ de Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Inte sta risonansa, o campo magnetico e e onde radio fan scì che i atomi emettan di piccin segnali radio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Inte l’anno 1970, Raymond Damadian, mego e reçercatô, o l’à scoverto e base pe-o deuvio da risonansa magnetica comme strumento pe-a diagnoxi in mëxiña.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Quattro anni apreuvo l’`stæto concesso un brevetto, che o l’é stæto o primmo brevetto do mondo rilasciou into campo da risonansa magnetica.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Do 1977 o dott. Damadian o l’à completou a construçion do primmo scanner MRI “còrpo intrego” che o l’à ciammou “indomabile”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: A communicaçion ascicrona a l’incoraggia o tempo pe-a riflescion e a reaçion a-i atri.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: A consente a-i studenti de travaggiâ a-o seu ritmo e de controllâ o ritmo de informaçioin didattiche.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Pe de ciù, gh’é ciù pöchi vincoli de oräio co-a poscibilitæ de oräi de travaggio flescibili (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: A deuvia de internet e do World Wide Web a consente a-i studenti de avei accesso a-e informaçioin inte chesesegge momento.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: I studenti peuan anche poñe de domande a-i instruttoî inte chesesegge momento da giornâ, e aspëtâse de respòste raxonevolmente rapide, incangio che aspëtâ scin a-o pròscimo incontro faccia à faccia.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: O metodo postmoderno de imprendimento o l’òffre a libertæ da-i assoluti. No existe unn solo bon metodo pe imprende.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: In effetti, no gh’é unna cösa boña da imprende. L’imprendimento o l’avvëgne inte l’esperiensa tra o studente e a conoscensa presentâ.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: A nòstra esperiensa attuale cont tutti i programmi televixivi basæ in sce l’imprendimento e a presentaçion de informaçion fanni-da-ti a l’inlustra questo ponto.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Tanti de niatri se ritreuvan à ammiâ un spettacolo televixivo ch’o n’informa de un proçesso ò de unn’esperiensa a-a quæ no parteçipiemo ni applichiemo mai quella conoscensa.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: No revixoniemo mai unna vettua, no construiemo mai un barchî into nòstro cortî, no aniemo mai in Perù pe esaminâ de antighe roiñe, no rimodelliemo mai a casa do nòstro vexin.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Graçie a-i collegamenti sottomarin in fibra òttica con l’Euröpa e a-o satellite à banda larga, a Groenlandia a l’é ben conligâ, co-o 93% da popolaçion ch’a l’à accesso à internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: O teu hotel ò i teu host (se ti stæ inte unna penscion ò inte unna casa privæ) avian probabilmente o wifi ò un PC connesso à internet e tutti i insediamenti avian un internet cafè ò un leugo pubrico con wifi pubrico.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Comme s’é za dito, sciben che o termine Eskimo o peu ëse ancon accettou inti Stati Unii, o l’é consciderou con unn’açeçion negativa da tante gente che vivan vexin inte l’Artico, mascime into Canadà.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Ascì ben che de vòtte se peu sentî di nativi da Groenlandia deuviâ sta paròlla, i foresti dovieivan çercâ de schivâla.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: I abitanti nativi da Groenlandia ciamman liatri mæximi co-o nomme de Inuit into Canadà e con quello de Kalaalleq (Kalaallit a-o plurale), saieiva à dî pròpio «abitante da Groenlandia», inta seu tæra.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: A criminalitæ e a cattia dispoxiçion verso i foresti in areo son praticamente desconiue in Groenlandia. Anche inte çittæ no gh’é de “zöne diffiçili”.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: O freido o l’é fòscia l’unico veo peigo che i impreparæ dovian affrontâ.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Se ti vixiti a Groenlandia inte stagioin freide (consciderando che con ciù ti væ à nòrd, con ciù faià freido) l’é essençiale portâ di vestî cadi à basta.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: E longhiscime giornæ da stæ peuan caxonâ di problemi à dormî à basta e i problemi de salue assoçiæ.
