text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Inta stæ beseugna fâ attençion anche a-e sinsae nòrdiche. Scieben che no trasmettan de marottie, peuan dâ fastidio.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Tante che l’economia de San Francisco a l’é ligâ a-o fæto che a l’é unn’attraçion turistica mondiale, a seu economia a l’é diverscificâ.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: I maggioî settoî de occupaçion son i serviçi profescionali, o governo, a finansa e o turismo.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: A seu frequente rappresentaçion in muxica, lettiatua e coltua popolare a l’à contribuio à fâ conosce a çittæ e i seu monumenti inte tutto o mondo.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco a l’à sviluppou unna grande infrastruttua turistica con numeroxi hotel, ristoranti e struttue congressuali de primm’ordine.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco o l’é ascì un di megio pòsti da naçion pe atre coxiñe asiatiche: coreaña, tailandeise, indiaña e giapponeise.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Viægiâ à Walt Disney World representa un importante pellegrinaggio pe tante famigge americañe.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: A vixita “tipica” a prevedde un xeuo à l’ariopòrto internaçionâ de Orlando, un autobus pe un hotel Disney in sciô pòsto, trnascorrî circa unna settemaña sensa lasciâ a propietæ Disney e tornâ a casa.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Gh’é infinie variaçioin poscibili, ma questo o l’arresta quello che a ciù parte de persoñe a l’intende quande parla de “anâ à Disney World”.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Tanti biggetti vendui in sce di sciti de aste comme eBay ò Craigslist son biggetti park-hopper de ciù giorni parçialmente utilizzæ.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Sciben che questa a l’é unn’attivitæ ben ben commune, a l’é vietâ da-a Disney: i biggetti no son trasferibili.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Pe poei fâ campeggio a-o de sotta do Grand Canyon ghe veu un permisso de viægio pe l’introtæra.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: I permisci en limitæ pe protezze o canyon e peuan ëse accattæ da-o primmo giorno do meise, quattro meixi primma de quello do comenso da validitæ do permisso mæximo.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Pe sta raxon, un permisso de viægio pe l’introtæra ch’o segge valido à partî da un giorno chesesegge de mazzo o s’attreuva za da-o primmo de zenâ.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: I pòsti ligæ a-e zöne che gustan de ciù, come o Bright Angel Campground da arente a-o Phantom Ranch, pe-o sòlito vëgnan tutti piggiæ za a-o primmo giorno averto a-e prenotaçioin.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Gh’é unna quantitæ de permisci limitâ a-i primmi che fan domanda e che se presentan de persoña.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Intrâ in Africa meridionale in machina o l’é un mòddo fantastico pe vedde tutte e bellesse da region e pe razzonze di pòsti feua da-e normale rotte turistiche.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Questo o peu ëse fæto con unna machina normale con unna pianificaçion attenta, ma un 4x4 o l’é fortemente conseggiou e tanti pòsti son accescibili solo con un 4x4 à passo erto.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Tegni presente, tanto che ti pianifihi, che sciben che l’Africa meridionale a l’é stabile, no tutti i paixi vexin ô son.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: I requixii e i costi pe-o visto varian da naçion à naçion e son influensæ da-o paise de proveniensa.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Ògni paise o l’à ascì de lezze uniche che dixan che strumenti de emergensa devan ëse presenti in machina.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Vicotria Falls a l’é unna çittæ inta parte occidentale do Zimbawe, a-o de là do confin de Livingstone, Zambia e vexin a-o Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: A çittæ a se treuva subito da arente a-e cascæ, che son a prinçipâ attraçion, ma sta popolare destinaçion turistica a l’òffre segge a-i avventuê segge a-i turisti tanto opportunitæ pe un soggiorno ciù longo.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Inta stagion ciuvosa (da novembe à marso) o volumme de l’ægua o saià maggiô e e cascæ saian ciù spettacolari.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Ti te bagni de seguo se ti attraversi o ponto ò ti cammñi longo i sentê che gian vexin a-e cascæ.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: D’atra parte, l’é pròpio perché o volumme de l’ægua o l’é coscì erto che a teu vixon de cascæ reali a saià oscuâ – da tutta l’ægua!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Tomba de Tetankhamon (KV62). KV62 a porrieiva ëse a ciù famosa de tombre da Valley, tiatro da scoverta do 1922 de Howard Carter da seportua reale squæxi intatta do zoveno re.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Con tutto, à peto da ciù parte de atre tombe reali, a tomba de Tutankhamon a merita giusto unna vixita, ësendo ben ben ciù picciña e con decoraçioin limitæ.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Chionque o segge interessou à vedde i segni do danno fæto a-a mummia inti tentativi de tiâla feua da-o cataletto o saià deluso perché se vedde solo a testa e e spalle.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: E favolose ricchesse da tomba no son ciù a-o seu interno, ma son stæte trasferie a-o Museo Egiçio do Cairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: I vixitatoî con un tempo limitou faieivan megio à passâ o seu tempo da un atra parte.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km à su-òvest de Siem Reap. Questo tempio in çimma à unna colliña o l’é stæto construio a-a fin do secolo IX, into regno do re Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: L’atomosfea luvega do tempio e a vista in sciô lago Tonle Sap rendan a montâ a-a colliña degna de nòtta.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Unna vixita a-o scito a peu ëse combinâ ben con unna gita in barco a-o lago.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: L’Angkor Pass o l’é neçessäio pe intrâ into tempio, donca no ascordâ de portâte apreuvo o passapòrto quande ti væ à Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Gerusalemme a l’é a capitale e a çittæ a ciù grande de Isræle, sciben che a ciù parte di atri paxi e e Naçioin Unie no â riconoscian comme capitale de Isræle.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: L’antiga çittæ in scê colliñe da Giudea a l’à unna stöia affascinante ch’a dua da miggiæa de anni.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: A çittæ a l’é sacra a-e træ religioin monoteiste: ebraismo, crestianeximo e islam, e a fa da centro spirituale, religioso e colturale.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Pe caxon do scignificato religioso da çittæ, e mascime di numeroxi sciti de l’aria da Çittæ Vegia, Gerusalemme a l’é uña de prinçipale destinaçioin turistiche in Isræle.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Gerusalemme a l’à un muggio de sciti stòrichi, archeològichi e colturali, insemme à di vivaci centri comerciali pin de gente, di bar e di ristoranti.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: L’Ecuador o domanda che i çittæn cubben riçeivan unna lettera de invito avanti de intrâ in Equador à traverso ariopòrti internaçionæ ò ponti de ingresso de frontea.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Sta lettia a dev’ëse legalizzâ da-o Ministero di Affari Esteri ecuadorian e stisfâ çerti requixii.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Sti requixii son pensæ pe avei un flusso migratöio organizzou tra i doî paixi.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: I çittæn cubben che son titolari de unna carta verde di Stati Unii dovieivan vixitâ un Consolou ecuadorian pe ottegnî unn’exençion à sto requixio.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: O passapòrto o dev’ëse valido a-o manco scin à 6 meixi dòppo e dæte do viægio. L’é neçessaïo un biggetto de anæta e retorno pe demostrâ a duâ do viægio.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: I tour operator ciù econòmichi son pe-i gruppi ciù grendi, donca se t’ê solo ò con un amigo, preuva à incontrâ atre persoñe e forma un gruppo da quattro à sëi persoñe pe unna megio tariffa à persoña.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Con tutto, questo in realtæ o no dovieiva riguardâte, perché soventi i turisti vëgnan rebellæ in gio pe impî e vettue.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: In realtæ o pâ ciù che atro un mòddo pe sponciâ e persoñe à credde de dovei pagâ de ciù.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: A sovrasta l’estremitæ nòrd de Machu Picchu sta montagna rabita, soventi sfondo de tante föto de roiñe.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Pâ un pittin descoraggiante da-o basso, e a l’é unna montâ rabita e diffiçile, ma e persoñe ciù raxonevolmente in forma dovieivan fâghela into gio de 45 menuti pöcassæ.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: I scæn de pria son pösæ longo a ciù parte do persorso, e inti tratti ciù rabiti di cavi de äsâ forniscian unn’arrembaggia de suppòrto.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Dito questo, aspëtite de ëse sensa sciou e fanni attençion inte parte ciù rabite, mascime se bagnæ, perché peuan vegnî fito peigose.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Gh’é unna gròtta piccinetta vexin a-a çimma ch’a dev’ëse attraversâ, a l’é ciutòsto bassa e ciufito streita.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Pe vedde i sciti e a fauna sarvæga de Galapagos l’é mgio fâlo da-a barca, pròpio comme o l’à fæto Charles Darwin do 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Ciù de 60 da croxea sorcan e ægue de Galapagos, con de dimenscioin compreise tra 8 e 100 passaggê.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: A ciù parte de persoñe a prenòtta o pòsto con largo antiçipo (stante che e barche pe sòlito en piñe inte l’erta stagion).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Asseguite che l’agente à traverso o quæ ti prenòtti o segge un specialista de Galapagos, con unna boña coonoscensa de unna grande varietæ de nave.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Questo o garantià che i teu interesci e/ò vincoli particolari conrespondan a-a nave che ciù se gh’adatta.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Avanti de l’arrivo di spagnòlli, do secolo XVI, o Cile do nòrd o l’ea sotta o dominio Inca, tanto che i indigeni Araucani (Mapuche) stavan into Cile centrale e meridionale.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: I Mapuche son stæti anche un di urtimi gruppi indigeni americhen indipendenti, che no son stæti sciorbii areo da-o dominio de lengua spagnòlla scin à dòppo l’indipendensa do Cile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Sciben che o Cile o l’à diciarou l’indipendensa do 1810 (into mezo de guære napoleòniche che an lasciou a Spagna sensa un governo centrale fonçionante pe un pâ de anni) a vittöia decixiva in scî spagnòlli a no l’é stæta ottegnua scin a-o 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: A Repubrica Dominicaña (in spagnòllo República Dominicana) o l’é un paise inti Caraibi ch’o s’estende in sciâ meitæ ponentiña de l’isoa d’Hispaniola, ch’o scomparte insemme à Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: In azzonta à de ciazze d’æña gianca e à di paisaggi montagnoxi, o paise o presenta a primma çittæ europea stæta fondâ inte Americhe, che oua a l’é parte de Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: In antigo l’isoa a l’é stæta abitâ da-i Tain e da-i Caribi. I Caribi ean unna popolaçion de lengua arawaka comparsa, da-o ciù a-o meno, do 10.000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Passou quarche anno dòppo l’arrivo di esploratoî europëi, a popolaçion di Tainos a l’ea stæta significativamente reduta da-i conquistatoî spagnòlli.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Segondo quello ch’o conta fræ Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias), da-o 1492 a-o 1498 i conquistatoî spagnòlli avieivan assascinou 100.000 Tain pöcassæ.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Giardin de l’Union. Sto spaçio o l’é stæto construio comme pòrtego pe un convento do secolo XVII, do quæ o Tempio de San Diego o l’é a sola construçion sopravisciua.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Oua a fonçioña comme ciassa centrale e gh’é sempre tante cöse da fâ, giorno e neutte.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Gh’é diversci ristoranti tutti d’in gio a-o giardin, e de poidisnâ e de seia se tëgne soventi di conçerti de badda into gazebo centrale.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Caroggio do Baxo). Doî poggiòli separæ da soli 69 citti allugan unn’antiga lezzendia d’amô.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Pe pöche palanche di figgeu ve contian a stöia.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: L’isoa de Bowen a l’é unna gita popolare de un giorno, ò unn’escurscion do fin de settemaña ch’a l’òffre kayak, escurscionismo, bitteghe, ristoranti e atro ancon.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Sta communitæ autentica a se treuva à Howe Sound, giusto feua Vancouver, e a l’é accescibile de lengê graçie à di tacsi d’ægua de linia in partensa da Granville Island, into centro de Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Pe quelli che amman e attivitæ à l’äia averta, un trekking longo o corrieu Sea to Sky o l’é primmäio.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (à unn’oa e meza de machina da Vancouver) o l’é cao ma famoso graçie a-e Olimpiade d’inverno do 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: D’inverno, gödite quarcheduña tre e megio sciæ do Nòrd America, e in estæ preuva unna vertadea mountain bike.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: I permissi devan ëse prenotæ in antiçipo. Ti devi avei un permisso pe dormî à Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena a l’é a sola staçion di ranger che a l’òffre allögio in dormitöio e pasti cadi, in ciù do campezzo. La Leona, San Pedrillo e Los Patos òffran solo o campezzo sensa o serviçio de ristoraçion.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: L’é poscibile ottegnî i permissi pe-o parco direttamente da-a staçion di ranger Puerto Jiménez, ma no se accetta e carte de credito
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: O Serviçio Parco (MINAE) o no rilascia de permissi de sòsta con ciù de un meise de antiçipo à peto de l’arrivo previsto.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol o lòffre un serviçio de prenotaçion a-o costo de 30 USD ò 10 USD pe-i abbonamenti giornalieri; i detaggi in sciâ seu pagina Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: E Isoe Cook son un stato de isoe in libera assoçiaçion co-a Neuva Zelanda, ch’o sta in Polinesia, into mezo de l’Oceano Pacifico meridionale.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: O l’é un arçipelago con 15 isoe spantegæ in sce 2,2 mioin de km2 de oceano.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Co-o mæximo fuso oräio de Hawaii, e isoe son conscideræ de vòtte comme e “Hawaii sottañe”.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Sciben che ciù piccin, o regòrda à çerti vixitatoî ançien e Hawaii primma de ëse Stato, sensa tutti i grendi hotel turistichi e i atri sviluppi.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: E Isoe Cook no an de çittæ ma son compòste da 15 isoe diverse. E prinçipæ son Rarotonga e Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Inti paixi sviluppæ, fornî di bed and breakfast de lusso o l’é stæto elevou à unna meña de forma d’arte.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Inta fascia erta, se capisce che i B&B competan mascime in sce doe cöse prinçipæ: pernottamento e colaçion.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Apreuvo à questo, inti megio stabilimenti de sto tipo l’é façile trovâ a giancaia da letto ciù lussuosa, magara unna traponta fæta à man ò un letto antigo.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: A colaçion a peu includde de deliçie de stagion da region, ò de specialitæ do padron de casa.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: L’ambientaçiona porrieiva ëse un vegio casamento stòrico con di mòbili antighi, di giardin tegnui ben e unna pisciña.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Intrâ in machina e partî pe un longo viægio o l’à o fascino intrinseco inta seu semplicitæ.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: À differensa de vettue ciù grendi, probabilmente t’æ za familiaritæ co-a guidda da teu machina e ti ne conosci i limiti.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Ciantâ unna tenda inte unna propietæ privâ ò inte unna çittæ de chesesegge dimenscion peu attirâ de lengê de attençioin indexideræ.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: A-e curte, deuviâ a machina o l’é un mòddo milia pe fâ un viægio on the road, ma de ræo de pe lê o l’é un mòddo pe accampâse.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: O campezzo in machina o l’é poscibile se se dispoñe de un grande minivan, un SUV, unna Sedan ò unna Statio Wagon con di setti che s’arreversan.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Çerti hotel an unn’ereditæ da l’etæ de l’öo de ferovie à vapô e di transatlantichi; avanti da segonda guæra mondiale, do secolo XIX ò do comenso do secolo XX.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Sti hotel ean o pòsto into quæ abitava i ricchi e i famoxi de l’epoca e soventi aveivan unna coxiña raffinâ e unna vitta notturna.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Fan parte do seu carattere anche i arredi à l’antiga, a farta di ciù moderni comfort e unna çerta vetustitæ aggaibâ.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Sciben che pe sòlito son de propietæ privâ, de vòtte òspitan di cappi de stato in vixita, e di atri dignitäi.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Un viægiatô con un muggio de dinæ o porrieiva piggiâ in conscideraçion un xeuo intorno a-o mondo, interrompio da di soggiorni inte tanti de sti hotel.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Unna ræ de scangio de ospitalitæ a l’é l’organizzaçion ch’a mette in contatto i viægiatoî co-e gente do pòsto inte çittæ che vixitian.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Pe intrâ à fâ parte de unna tale ræ pe sòlito ghe veu solo a compilaçion de un mòdolo online, sciben quarche ræ a l’òffre ò a domanda unna verifica in ciù.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Vëgne donca fornio un elenco di host disponibili in formou de papê e/ò in lina, de vòtte con de referense e de reçenscioin di atri viægiatoî.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing a l’é stæta fondâ into zenâ do 2004 dòppo che o programmatô de computer Casey Fenton o l’à trovou un xeuo econòmico pe l’Islanda ma o no l’aiva un pòsto donde dormî.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: O l’à mandou unn’email a-i studenti de l’universcitæ locale e o l’à riçevuo un numero stramesuou de offerte pe l’allögio de badda.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: I ostelli se rviòlzan ciù che atro a-i zoeni – un òspite tipico o l’é in scî vint’anni – ma de spesso ti peu trovâ anche di viægiatoî ciù grendi.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: E famigge son un spettacolo raro, ma çerti ostelli ê consentan inte de stançie privæ.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: A çittæ de Pechin in Ciña a saià a çittæ ch’a l’ospitià i Zeughi Olimpichi Invernali do 2022, cösa che â faià a primma çittæ à avei ospitou segge e Olimpiade estive che quelle invernali.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pechin a l’ospitià e çeimònie de avertua e de særo e i eventi in sce giassa indoor.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Di atri eventi sciistichi se tegnian into comprensöio sciistico de Taizicheng à Zhangijakou, à circa 220 km (140 miggia ) da Pechin.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: A ciù parte di tempi a l’à un festival annuale ch’o va da-a fin de novembre a-a meitæ de mazzo, ch’o varia in base a-o calendäio annuale de ògni tempio.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: A ciù parte de feste do tempio a vëgne celebrâ comme parte de l’anniversäio do tempio ò do nataliçio da divinitæ prescidente, ò de chesesegge atro evento importante ligou a-o tempio.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: E feste di tempi do Kerala son ben ben interessanti da vedde, con un corossezzo regolare de elefanti decoræ, l’orchestra do tempio e atri festezzamenti.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Unna Fea Mondiale (ciammâ pe sòlito Esepoxiçion Mondiale, ò semplicemente Expo) a l’é un grande festival internaçionâ de arte e sciense.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: I paixi che parteçipan de mostre artistiche e educative inti padiggioin naçionali pe exibî e costioin mondiale ò a coltua e a stöia do seu paise.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: E Espoxiçioin de Orticoltua son di eventi specializzæ che mettan in mostra de espoxiçioin floreali, di giardin botanichi e tutto quello che o l’à relaçion co-e ciante.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Sciben che in teoria peuan tegnîse tutti i anni (à patto che in paixi despægi) in prattica no ô fan.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Sti eventi pe sòlito duan da-i trei a-i sëi meixi e se svòlzan inte di sciti no inferioî à 50 ettari.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Gh’é un muggio de diversci formæ de pellicole che son stæti deuviæ into corso di anni. A pellicola standard de 35 mm (36mm x 24mm) a l’é de do bello a ciù commune.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Pe sòlito a peu ëse rifornia de lengê se a finisce e a l’òffre unna risoluçion ciù ò meno paragonabile à unna DSLR atttuale.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Çerte fötocamie à pellicola de medio formou deuvian un formou 6 x 6 cm, ciù precisamente un negativo 56 x 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Questo o fornisce unna risoluçion squæxi quattro vòtte quella de un negativo da 35 mm (3136 mm2 contra 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: A fauna a l’é un di motivi ciù impegnativi pe un fötografo e a l’à beseugno de unna combinaçion de boña fortuña, paçiensa, esperiensa e boña attressatua.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: A fötografia naturalistica a l’é de spesso dæta pe scontâ, ma comme a fötografia in areo, unn’imagine a vâ de ciù de mille paròlle.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: A fötografia naturalistica a domanda soventi un teleobiettivo longo, anche se i oggetti comme un sciammo de öxelli ò unna creatua picciña an beseugno de di atri obiettivi.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Tanti animæ esòtichi son diffiçili da trovâ e i parchi de vòtte an de regole in sce comme scattâ de föto pe finalitæ comerciali.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: I animæ sarvæghi porrieivan ëse timidi ò aggrescivi. L’ambiente o porrieiva ëse freido, cado ò ostile inte quarche atro mòddo.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: O mondo o l’à ciù de 5.000 lengue despægie, de quæ ciù de vinti con 50 mioin ò ciù de parlanti.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Anche e paròlle scrite son de spesso ciù façili da capî à peto de paròlle prononçiæ. Questo o l’é particolarmente veo pe-i adressi, che de spesso son diffiçili da prononçiâ in mòddo comprenscibile.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Tante naçioin intreghe parlan corentemente l’ingleise, e inte ancon de ciù un o se peu aspëtâ unna conoscensa limitâ, mascime tra i ciù zoeni.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Imagiña, se ti veu, un mancunian, bostonian, giamaican e un de Sydney assettæ à unna töa che çeñan inte un ristornate de Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: S’intrattëgnan l’un con l’atro co-e stöie de seu çittæ d’origine, contæ co-e seu còccine despægie e into zerbo locale.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: L’accatto de çibbo inti supermercoei o l’é pe-o sòlito o mòddo o ciù econòmico pe nutrîse. Sensa poscibilitæ de coxinâ, però, e çernie se limitan a-i mangiæ za pronti.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Sempre ciù de spesso i supermercoei son apreuvo à inandiâ unna seçion ciù varia de mangiæ za pronti. Çerti forniscian fiña un forno à microonde ò atri mezzi pe ascädâ o mangiâ.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Inte çerti paixi ò tipi de bitteghe l’é presente a-o manco un ristorante in loco, soventi ciufito informale e à bon patto.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Stampa e pòrta con ti de còpie da teu pòlissa e di detaggi do contatto do teu asseguatô.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Devan mostrâ l’adresso email de l’asseguatô e i numeri de telefono internaçionæ pe conseggi/autorizzaçioin e reclammi.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Aggi unn’atra còpia into bagaggio e online (email à ti mæximo con alligou, ò memorizzâ into “cloud”).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Se ti viægi con un laptop ò un tablet, conservine unna còpia inta memöia ò into disco (accescibile sensa Internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Fornisci ascì de còpie da pòlissa/contatto a-i compagni de viægio e a-i parenti e a-i amixi à casa, dispòsti à aggiuttâ.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: E alce (conosciue anche comme alce americaña) no son aggrescive da pe lô, ma se difendian se perçepiscian unna menassa.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Quande e persoñe no veddan e alce comme potençialmente peigose, peuan avvexinâse tròppo da arente e mettise in peigo.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Beivi de bevande alcòliche con moderaçion. L’alcol o corpisce tutti in mòddo diverso, e conosce o teu limite l’é assæ importante.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: E poscibili marottie à longo termine dovue a-o consummo eccescivo de alcol peuan includde i danni a-i figæto e sciña a cecitæ e a mòrte. O peigo potençiale o cresce quande se consumma de l’alcol produto illegalmente.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: I licoî illegali peuan contegnî diverse impuritæ peigose, tra e quæ o metanölo, ch’o peu caxonâ a cecitæ ò a mòrte anche in quantitæ picciñe.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: I spegetti peuan ëse ciù econòmichi inte un paise foresto, mascime inti paixi à basso reddito, donde o costo do travaggio o l’é inferiô.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Piggia in conscideraçion l’idea de sottopoñite à unna vixita oculistica, sorviatutto se l’asseguaçion â creuve, e de portâte apreuvo a riçetta da presentâ da unn’atra parte.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: I tiæ de marca de fascia erta che s’attreuvan inte ste aree peuan avei doî problemi; çerti porrieivan ëse de imitaçioin e quelli vëi importæ porrieivan ëse ciù cäi che à casa.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: O cafè a l’é uña de materie primme ciù scangiæ a-o mondo e probabilmente ti peu trovâne tanti tipi inta teu region d’origine.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Con tutto, gh’é tanti mòddi despægi de beive o cafè in gio pe-o mondo, che va a peña de provâ.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: O canyoning (ò canyoneering) o consciste inte l’anâ into fondo de un canyon, sciuto ò pin d’ægua.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: O canyoning o combiña di elementi do neuo, de l’arrampinâ e do sato, ma o domanda relativamente pöco allenamento, ò forma fixica, pe comensâ (à peto de l’arrampinâ in sce ròcca, a-e immerscioin subaquee ò a-o sci arpin, pe exempio).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: L’escurscionismo a l’é unn’attivitæ à l’averto ch’a consciste into camminâ inte di ambienti naturali, de spesso in sce di sentê da escurscionista.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: L’escurscionismo diurno o prevedde da de distanse ciù curte de un miggio scin à distanse maggioî che peuan ëse coverte inte un giorno solo.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Pe un escurscion de un giorno longo un sentê façile l’é neçessäio di preparativi piccin, e chesesegge persoña un pittin allenâ a peu gödîsela.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: E famigge con di figgeu piccin porrieivan avei beseugno de ciù tanti preparativi, ma unna giornâ à l’äia averta a l’é poscibile de lengê sciña con di figgeu da nascion ò de l’asilo.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: À livello internaçionâ, gh’é squæxi 200 organizzaçion de running tour. A ciù parte de lô a travaggia in mòddo indipendente.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: O successô de Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours, o mette in ræ de dozzeñe de fornitoî de corsa à vista inte quattro continenti.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Con de reixe inte Running Tours Barcelona de Barçeloña e Running Copenhagen de Copenaghen, o l’é stæto fito razzonto da Running Tours Prague con sede à Praga e atri.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Gh’é tante cöse che ti devi piggiâ in conscideraçion avanti e quande ti viægi da quarche parte.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Quande ti væagi aspëtite che e cöse no seggian comme saieivan “à casa”. I mòddi, e lezze, o çibbo, o traffego, l’allögio, i standard, a lengua e coscì via, cangian inte unna çerta mesua à peto de donde ti vivi.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Questo o l’é un quarcösa che ti devi sempre dâghe a mente, pe evitâ de deluxoin ò fòscia anche o desgusto pe-i mòddi locali de fâ e cöse.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: E agençie de viægio existan da-o secolo XIX. Un agente de viægio o l’é pe sòlito unna boña opçion pe un viægio ch’o vagghe ciù là da precedente esperiensa de natua, coltua, lengua, ò paixi à basso reddito.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Sciben che a ciù parte de agençie a segge dispòsta à accettâ a ciù parte de prenotaçion ordenäie, tanti agenti son specializzæ inte di tipi particolari de viægio, de fasce de budget ò de destinaçioin.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Peu ëse megio affidâse à un agente ch’o prenòtta de spesso di viægi pægi a-i teu.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Danni unn’euggiâ à che viægi o l’é apreuvo à promeuve, segge in sciô scito web segge inte unna vedriña.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Se ti veu vedde o mondo à bon patto, pe neçescitæ, stile de vitta ò sfidda, gh’é diversci mòddi pe fâlo.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Fondamentalmente se dividdan inte doe categorie: ò ti travaggi tanto che ti viægi, ò çerchi de limitâ e teu speise. Questo articolo o l’é incentrou in sce quest’urimo.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Pe quelli che son dispòsti à sacrificâ comfort, tempo e prevedibilitæ pe redue e speise vexin a-o zero, che ammien o budget minimo de viægio.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: O conseggio o presuppoñe che i viægiatoî no arröban, no trasgrediscian, no parteçipan a-o mercou illegale, no domandan a limòxina e no sfruttan diversamente atre persoñe pe-o seu guägno.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Un checkpoint pe l’immigraçion o l’é pe sòlito a primma tappa quande se desbarca da un aerio, unna nave ò un atro mezzo.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Inte çerti treni transfrontalê e ispeçioin vëgnan effettuæ in sciô treno in corsa, e ti doviësci aveighe apreuvo un documento de identitæ valido quande ti monti in sce un de quelli treni.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: In scî treni co-o wagon-lit i passapòrti peuan ëse retiæ da-o conduttô in mòddo da no interrompî o seunno.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: A registraçion o l’é un requixito in ciù pe-o proçesso de visto. Inte çerti paixi ti devi registrâ da-e autoritæ locale a teu presensa e l’adresso a-o quæ ti stæ.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Questo o porrieiva domandâ a compilaçion de un mòdolo co-a poliçia locale ò unna vixita a-i uffiçi de immigraçion.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Inte tanti paixi con sta lezze chì, i hotel gestian a registraçion (asseguite de domandâ).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Inti atri caxi solo chi o soggiorna a-o de feua de struttue ricettive o deve registrâse. Do resto questo o rende a lezze ben ben ciù oscua, donca screuvilo in anticipo.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: L’architettua a se òccupa da progettaçion e da construçion di casamenti. L’architettua de un pòsto a l’é de spesso unn’attraçion turistica da pe lê.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Tanti casamenti son ciutòsto belli da vedde e a vista da un palaçio erto ò da un barcon misso ben a peu ëse unna bellessa da ammiâ.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: L’architettua a se sovrappoñe notevolmente à di atri campi tra i quæ l’urbanistica, l’inzegneria civile, e arte decorative, l’interior design, e l’architettua do paisaggio.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Stante o mai tanto remöti che son ben ben de puebli, no ti saiæ bon de trovâ unna quantitæ interessante de vitta notturna sensa viægiâ à Albuquerque ò à Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Con tutto, squæxi tutti i casinò elencæ chì de d’ato servan de bevande e tanti de liatri pòrtan de l’intrattegnimento brandizzou (mascime quelli grendi che stan subito feua da Albuquerque e Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Attençion: i bar de çittæ picciñe chì no son sempre di pòsti boin pe rilassâse pe-i vixitatoî feua Stato.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Pe primma cösa, o New Mexico do nòrd o l’à di problemi scignificativi co-a guidda in stato de imbriægatua, e a concentraçion de guiddatoî imbiræghi a l’é erta vexin a-i bar de çittæ picciñe.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: I murales ò i scarabòcci indexideræ son conosciui comme graffiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Sciben che l’é tutt’atro che un fenòmeno moderno, a ciù parte de persoñe probabilmente l’assòcia a-i zoeni che vandalizzavan e propietæ pubriche deuviando a vernixe spray.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Con tutto, ancheu gh’é di artisti de graffiti affermæ, di eventi de graffiti e de miage “legali”. I dipinti de graffiti inte sto contesto assomeggian de spesso à de òpie d’arte ciutòsto che à di tag che no se lezan.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: O tio do boomerang a l’é unn’abilitæ popolare che tanti turisti vorrieivan ottegnî.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Se ti veu imprende à tiâ un boomerang ch’o torna a-a teu man, asseguite d’avei un boomerang adattou à tornâ.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: A ciù parte di boomerang disponibili in Australia son, de fæti, sensa ritorno. L’é megio pe-i prinçipianti no provâ a tiâ co-o vento
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Un pasto Hangi o vëgne cheutto inte unna fòssa cada into terren.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: A fòssa a vëgne rescädâ con de prie cade de un feugo, ò inte çerti ponti o calô geotermico o rende e aree do terren naturalmente cade.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: L’hangi o l’é deuviou soventi pe inandiâ unna çeña tradiçionâ, tipo ròsto.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Diversci pòsti a Rotorua òffran un hangi geotermico, tanto che atri hangi peuan ëse assazzæ à Christchurch, Wellington e da atre parte.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail o l’à doe classe de treni pendolari à Cape Town e vexin: MetroPlus (dito ascì First Class) e Metro (dito ascì Third Class).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus o l’é ciù còmodo e meno affollou, ma un pittin ciù caistioso, sciben che ciù econòmico che i normali biggetti da metropolitaña in Euröpa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Ògni treno o l’à segge di vagoin MetroPlus segge di vagoin Metro; e caròsse MetroPlus son sempre a-a fin do treno ciù vexin à Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Transpòrto pe-i atri – No perde mai de vista e teu valixe, sorviatutto quande t’ê apreuvo à attraversâ i confin naçionæ.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Ti porriësci ritrovâte à ëse usou comme portatô de dröga sensa saveilo, cösa ch’a te portià unna gran quantitæ de guai.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Questo compòrta aspëtâ in fia, perché i chen antidröga peuan vegnî deuviæ inte chesesegge momento sensa preavviso.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Çerti paixi an de puniçioin in davei draconiañe anche pe-i primmi reati; ste chì peuan includde de peñe de detençion de ciù de 10 anni, ò a mòrte.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: I bagaggi incustodii son oggetto de ladronisso e peuan anche attirâ l’attençion de autoritæ che diffidan da-e menasse de bomboe.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: À casa, pe caxon de st’espoxiçion constante a-i bacilli locali, l’é ben ben probabile che ti ne seggi immune.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Ma inte de atre parte do mondo, donde a fauna di bacilli a l’é neuva pe ti, l’é ben ben ciù probabile che ti ti gh’aggi di problemi.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Pe de ciù, inti climmi ciù cadi i bacilli crescian ciù fito e sopravvivan ciù à longo a-o de feua do còrpo.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Coscì i fragelli de Delhi Belly, a malediçion do Faraon, a vendetta de Montezuma e i seu tanti amixi.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Comme pe-i problemi respiatöi inti climmi ciù freidi, i problemi de intestin inti climmi cadi son ciufito communi e inta ciù parte di caxi son decisamente angoscioxi ma no peigoxi in davei.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Se ti viægi pe-a primma vòtta inte un paise in via de sviluppo – ò inte unna neuva parte do mondo – no sottovalutâ o potençiale shock colturale.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Tanti viægiatoî ricorrenti e capaçi son stæti sobbaccæ da-a novitæ di viægi inti paixi in via de sviluppo, donde tante picciñe differense colturali peuan sommâse fito.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Sorviatutto inti teu primmi giorni, conscidera de concedite unna matteia in hotel, do mangiâ e di serviçi in stile occidentale e de qualitæ, pe aggiuttâte à acclimmatâte.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: No stâ à dormî in sce unna straponta ò unna strapontiña pe tæra inte de zöne donde no se conosce a fauna locale.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Se t’æ l’intençion de accampâte, pòrtite unna brandiña da campezzo ò unn’amaca pe tegnîte lontan da-i serpenti, e tancoe e scimili.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Impi a teu casa con un ricco caffè a-a mattin e unna rilassante camamilla a seia.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Quande t’ê in soggiorno, t’æ o tempo pe fâte un regallo e dedicâ quarche menuto in ciù pe inandiâ quarcösa de speciale.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Se ti te senti ciù avventuroso, cheuggi l’occaxon pe spremme ò inandiâ quarche frollou:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: magara ti descroviæ unna bevanda semplice che ti porriæ preparâ a colaçion quande ti torniæ a-a teu vitta cotidiaña.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Se ti vivi inte unna çittæ con unna coltua variegâ do beive, vanni inte un bar ò inte un pub inte di quartê che no ti frequenti.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Pe chi no conosce o zerbo mego, e paròlle infettivo e contaggioso an di scignificati distinti.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Unna marottia infettiva a l’é quella caxonâ da un agente patògeno, comme un virus, un bacillo, un fonzo ò di atri parasciti.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Unna marottia contaggiosa a l’é unna marottia ch’a se trasmette de lengê trovandose inte vexinanse de unna persoña infetta.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Tanti governi domandan a-i vixitatoî che intran ò a-i rescidenti che sciòrtan da-i seu paixi de ëse vaccinæ contra unna serie de marottie.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Sti requixii peuan de spesso dipende da-i paixi che un viægiatô o l’à vixitou ò o l’intende vixitâ.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Un di ponti fòrti de Charlotte, into Nòrd Carolina, o l’é d’avei tante opçioin d’erta qualitæ pe-e famigge.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Tante vòtte i rescidenti de atre regioin mensuñan o carattere averto de gente comme raxon prinçipâ pe anâghe à stâ, e de spesso chi vixita a çittæ o â treuva façile da gödî insemme a-i figgeu.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Inti urtimi 20 anni, a quantitæ de servixi pensæ ascì pe-i figgeu inte Unptown Charlotte a l’é cresciua de forma esponençiale.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Pe commun i tascì no en guæi deuviæ da-e famigge à Charlotte, sciben che inte çerti caxi peuan vegnî ben.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Se i passaggê en ciù de doî s’à da pagâ unna tariffa supplementäia, donca st’opçion a porrieiva costâ ciù do neçessäio.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: L'Antartico o l'é o ciù freido pòsto in sciâ Tæra, e o circonda o Pölo Sud.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: E vixite di turisti en in scê còste, in çerchia de benstâ fixico, peuan avei leugo solo che de stæ Nov-Fre, e son pe gran mesua limitæ a-a Penisoa, e Isoe e o mâ de Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Un pâ de miggiæa de persoñe a vive chì coscì de stæ inte quattro dozzeñe de base pöcassæ sorvetutto inte quelle aree; un numeo ciù piccin o ghe sta d'inverno.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: L'introtæra Antartico o l'é un ätocian desolou coverto da 2-3 km de giassa.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Di viægi aerei occaxonali van inte l'introtæra, pe arpinismo ò pe arrivâ a-o Pölo, ch'o l'à unna gròssa base.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: A traversâ (ò autostradda) do Pölo Sud o l’é un percorso de 1600 km ch’o va da-a staçion McMurdo in sciô mâ de Ross fin a-o Pölo.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: A l’é neive compattâ con di derui stæti impii e segnæ con de bandee. A peu vegnî percorsa solo che da di trattoî speçializzæ che traspòrtan de slitte con carburante e provviste.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Queste no en guæi spedie, donca beseugna che o sentê o fasse unna longa deviaçioin in gio a-e montagne Transantartiche pe arrivâ in sce l’ätocian.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: A caxon ciù commun pe-i açidenti d’inverno son e stræ, e marciapê e mascime i scæn donde se scuggia.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Comme minimo aviei de beseugno de cäsæ con de seue adatte. E scarpe da stæ pe-o sòlito scuggian de lengê in sciâ giassa e in sciâ neive, e çerti stivæ da inverno en carenti ascì.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: O disegno o dev’ëse profondo tanto ch’abbasta, 5 mm (1/5 polliçi) ò de ciù, e o materiale abastansa sciòcco à de temperatue freide.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Çerti stivæ en provvisti de caro armou e gh’é un equipaggiamento d’azzonta, provvisto lê ascì de caro armou, pe-i terren donde l’é façile scuggiâ, adatto pe-a ciù parte de scarpe e di stivæ, pe-i tacchi ò pe-i tacchi e e seue.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: I tacchi devan ëse basci e larghi. Tante vòtte se spantega de l’æña, da giæa ò da sâ (cloruro de calcio) in scê stradde ò in scî sentê, de mòddo da avei unna megio traçion.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: E valanghe no son unn’anomalia; e deschinæ rapide peuan tegnî solo che tanta lentessa, e i volummi in de ciù deruan comme valanghe.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: O problema o l’é che a neive a s’attacca, e donca pe fâla deruâ a l’à beseugno de quarcösa che ghe dagghe do movimento; da neive ch’a chiña a porriæ descadenâ a reaçion pe tutto o resto.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: De vòtte l’elemento descadenante o peu ëse o sô ch’o l’ascada a neive, de atre a cheita d’atra neive, e de atre ancon di eventi naturali ò fiña provocæ da l’òmmo.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Un tornado a l’é unna colònna rotante d’äia de prescion assæ bassa, ch’a sussa l’äia d’in gio e a â sponcia drento de lê e verso l’erto.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Produxan di venti elevæ (de spesso à 100-200 migge à l’oa) che peuan sollevâ sciù pe l’äia di oggetti pesanti e portâli in gio tanto che o tornado o se mescia.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Comensan comme di tortaieu che chiñan da de nuvie che pòrtan burrasca e vëgnan di tornado quande toccan a tæra.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: I fornitoî de VPN (virtual private network) personali en unna mainea perfetta pe schivâ tanto a censua politica comme l’IP-geofiltering commerciale.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: En ciù potenti che i proxy web pe diversci motivi: readressan tutto o trafego Internet, e no solo quello http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Pe-o sòlito propoñan unna banda ciù larga e un servixo de megio qualitæ. En criptæ, e donca ciù diffiçili da spionezzâ.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Pe-o sòlito e açiende mediatiche mentan in sciâ finalitæ de sta cösa, co-o sostegnî ch’a segge fæta «pe prevegnî a pirattaia».
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Defæti i còdiçi regionali no an nisciun effetto in sciâ còpia feua da lezze; unna còpia bit-pe-bit de un disco a peu vegnî reproduta sensa problemi in un sce un dispoxitivo chesesegge donde o â fa l’originale.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: A vea finalitæ a l’é de dâ à ste compagnie ciù contròllo in scî seu mæximi mercoei; a costion a l’é quella de fâ giâ di dinæ.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Dæto che e ciammæ vëgnan fæte giâ in sce Internet, no gh’é de beseugno de deuviâ unna compagnia telefònica ligâ a-o pòsto donde se vive ò se viægia.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: No gh’é manco l’òbrigo d’ottegnî un numero locale da-a communitæ donde se vive; poei ottegnî unna connescion Internet satellitare inte aree sarvæghe de Chicken, Alaska e seleçionâ un numero segondo o quæ v’attroviësci inte l’assoiggiâ Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Tante vòtte doviei accattâve pe separou un numero globale ch’o permette a-i telefoni PSTN de ciammâve. A proveniensa de un numero a saià assæ importante pe-e gente che ve ciamman.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Applicaçioin de traduçion de testo in tempo reale – applicaçioin ch’en boñe à tradue automaticamente di segmenti intreghi de testo da unna lengua à unn’atra.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Çerte applicaçioin inte sta categoria peuan fiña tradue di testi inte de lengue foreste in scî cartelli ò atri oggetti do modo reale, se l’utente o ponta o seu smartphone verso de liatri.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: I motoî de traduçion an conosciuo di fòrti megioamenti e oua, o ciù de vòtte, dan de traduçioin ciù ò meno corrette (e sempre ciù de ræo paròlle tradute abrettio), ma beseugna à tutti i mòddi dâghe un pö de recatto, da-o momento che l’é delongo poscibile ch’aggian traduto mâ o contegnuo intrego.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Uña de applicaçioin prinçipæ inte sta categoria a l’é Google Translate, ch’a permette de tradue anche quande no s’é colligæ, unna vòtta che s’à descarregou i dæti da lengua dexidiâ.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Deuviâ unn’applicaçion de navegaçion GPS a porrieiva ëse a mainea ciù façile e conveniente pe mesciâse quande sei feua da-o vòstro paise.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: O permette de resparmiâ di dinæ in confronto à l’accatto de neuve mappe pe un GPS, à l’accatto de un dispoxitivo GPS autònomo ò a-o fæto de piggiâne un in pixon da unn’açienda d’automòbile à nöo.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Se into vòstro telefonin no ei unna connescion dæti Internet, ò sei feua de campo, porrieivan fonçionâ de forma limitâ ò no fonçionâ pe ninte.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Tutte e butteghe a-i canti de stradde presentan unna mescciua confusa de carte telefòniche prepagæ che peuan vegnî deuviæ da di telefoni normali ò à pagamento.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Sciben che a ciù parte de carte permettan de ciammâ da tutte e parte, çerte propoñan de speçifiche tariffe pe ciammâ verso di paixi determinæ.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: L’accesso à sti servixi o l’avvëgne pe mezo de unna telefonâ à un numero ch’o peu ëse ciammou de badda da-a ciù parte di paixi.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: E regole ligæ a-a fotografia normale van ascì pe-e registraçioin video, fòscia fiña ciù tanto.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Se no l’é permisso fâ de föto à quarösa, no besorriæ manco piggiâ in conscideraçion l’idea de poei registrâla in sce video.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Se deuviæ un dron, asseguæve in antiçipo in sce cöse poei filmâ e che permisci ò liçense ghe veu pe fâlo.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Fâ xoâ un dron vexin à un aereopòrto ò in sce un muggio de gente a l’é sempre unna gramma idea, ascì ben che inte quella zöna o no segge vietou da-a lezze.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: A-a giornâ d’ancheu i biggetti de compagnie aeree vëgnan accattæ de ræo pe mezo da compagnia mæxima sensa avei primma fæto de reçerche e avei paragonou i prexi.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: De vòtte o mæximo xeuo o peu avei di prexi assæ differenti inte diversci aggregatoî e primma de partî peu servî confrontâ i resultati de reçerca e ammiâ anche o scito da mæxima compagnia.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Se porriæ no ësighe de beseugno de un visto pe unna vixita curta inte çerti paixi comme turista ò pe travaggio, pe anâghe comme studente internaçionale pe commun serve un soggiorno ciù longo che quello de un turista chesesegge.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Normalmente pe stâ inte un paise foresto pe un periodo de tempo prolongou gh’é beseugno d’ottegnî un visto in antiçipo.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Pe commun pe-i visti da studenti gh’é di requixii e de proçedue despægi da quelli pe-i visti da normali turisti ò pe raxoin de travaggio.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Pe-a ciù parte di paixi gh’é de beseugno de unna lettia d’invio da l’instituçion donde se veu studiâ, e ascì unna preuva de poei mantegnîse economicamente a-o manco pe-o primmo anno de corso.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Pe avei di requixii detaggiæ informæve da l’instituçion e da-o departamento d’immigraçion do paise donde voei studiâ.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Se un o l’é un diplomatico, travaggiâ inte un atro continente veu dî che se besorrià presentâ a decciaraçion fiscale into paise donde s’à a rescidensa.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: O formoläio de decciaraçion fiscale o l’à unna struttua despægia à segonda do paise, e e tariffe e i scaggioin cangian fortemente da un paise à l’atro.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Inte çerti paixi federali, comme i Stati Unii ò o Canadà, a decciaraçion de tasce a l’à de regole à livello federativo che do scingolo stato; pe sta raxon e tariffe e scaggioin peuan cangiâ da unna region à l’atra.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Se quande se torna into paise originäio i contròlli do passapòrto en assenti, ò en solo che unna formalitæ, quelli da dugaña peuan ëse unna seccatua.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Asseguæve de conosce quello che poei ò che no poei portâve apreuvo, e de decciarâ tutto quello ch’o segge sorvia i limiti da lezze.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: A mainea ciù façile pe dâse à l’attivitæ econòmica da scrittua de viægio a l’é d’affinâ e abilitæ pe mezo da lettua de un blog de viægio ben conosciuo.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Dòppo ch’aviei piggiou confiansa co-a formattaçion e l’editing in sciô web, porriësci creâ o vòstro scito web.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Pratticâ do volontariato quande se viægia a l’é unn’òttima mainea de fâ a differensa, ma no se tratta solo che de dâ.
