text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Vive e fâ do volontariato inte un paise foresto a l’é unn’òttima mainea pe conosce unna coltua despægia, conosce neuve gente, imprende de ciù in sce un mæximo, arvî e seu prospettive e fiña aquixî de neuve abilitæ.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: A peu ëse ascì unna mainea pe arrecheugge quarche dinâ e permettise de vive da quarche parte pe ciù tempo, de za che tanti travaggi de volontariato forniscian un pòsto donde stâ e pagan o mangiâ, e çerti pagan fiña un stipendio piccinetto.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: I vichinghi deuviavan i percorsci de navegaçion da Ruscia pe razzonze o mâ Neigro e o mâ Caspio. Parte de sti percorsci peuan vegnî ancon deuviæ. Controllæ l’eventuale neçescitæ de permisci speciali, che porrieivan ëse diffiçili da ottegnî.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: O Canâ do mâ Gianco-Baltico o l’azzonze l’oçeano Artico a-o mâ Baltico, atraverso do lago Onega, o lago Ladoga e San Petersburgo, pe-o ciù pe mezo de sciummi e de laghi.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: O lago Onega o l’é connesso ascì a-a Vòlga, donca l’é delongo poscibile arrivâ da-o mâ Caspio pe mezo da Ruscia.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Stæ segui che unna vòtta arrivæ inti pòrti turistichi tutto o saià abastansa scontou. Intoppiei de atre gente che se mescian pe barco e che condividdian e seu informaçioin insemme à viatri.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Fondamentalmente attacchiei di avvixi pe offrî o vòstro aggiutto, camminando sciù pe-i meu, avvexinandove à de gente che nettezzan i seu yatch, çercando d’intrâ in contatto co-i mainæ into bar, etc.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Çercæ de parlâ à quante ciù persoñe poscibile. Dòppo un pö tutti ve conoscian e ve daian de informaçioin in sce che barco o çerca quarchidun.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Beseugna che çernei con attençion quella che voei ch’a segge a vòstra compagnia aerea pe-i viægi frequenti inte unna combinaçion de compagnie.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Sciben che peu pâ scontou che un o çerne a compagnia co-a quæ o viægia ciù tanto, ei da savei che i privilegi che ven offerto tante vòtte en despægi e i ponti pe-i viægiatoî frequenti peuan ëse ciù convenienti da unn’atra compagnia da mæxima combinaçion.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: De compagnie aeree comme Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways e Turkish Airlines an esteiso grandemente o seu servixo inte l’Africa, e propoñan de connescioin a-e ciù importante çittæ africañe à di prexi ciù competitivi che quelli de atre compagnie europee.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: À partî do 2014 Turkish Airlines a propoñe di xeui pe 39 destinaçioin inte 30 paixi africhen.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: S’ei do tempo de viægio in de ciù, controllæ comm’o l’é o vòstro preventivo de tariffa totale pe l’Africa à confronto con unna tariffa round-the-world.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: No ascordæve d’azzonze i costi extra di visti addiçionali, de tasce de partensa, do traspòrto pe tæra etc. pe tutti quelli pòsti feua de l’Africa.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Se voei xoâ in gio pe-o mondo solo che inte l’emisfëio sud, a çernia de xeui e destinaçioin a l’é limitâ pe-a farta de rotte transoçeaniche.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Nisciuña combinaçion de compagnie aeree a creuve e traversæ inte tutti trei i oçeani inte l’emisfëio sud (e SkyTeam a no creuve nisciuña de traversæ).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: À tutti i mòddi, Star Alliance a creuve tutte e aree feua che o Paçifico do sud-est da Santiago do Cile fin à Taiti, ch’a l’é unna træta de LATAM Overworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Sto xeuo a no l’é l’unica opçion se voei sätâ o Paçifico do sud e a còsta oçidentale de l’America do Sud. (ammiâ chì de sotta)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Do 1994 a region Nagorno-Karabakh de l’Azerbaigian, etnicamente armena, a l’à comensou unna guæra contra i azeri.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Con l’arrembo di ermeni l’é stæto creou unna neuva repubrica. À tutte e mainee, nisciuña naçion affermâ – manco l’Ermenia – a â reconosce in sciô cian offiçiâ.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: E discuscioin in sciâ region à livello diplomatico arroiñan sempre de ciù e relaçioin tra l’Ermenia e l’Azerbaigian.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: O quartê do canâ (Grachtengordel in olandeise) o l’é o famoso quartê do secolo XVII ch’o s’attreuva d’in gio a-o Binnenstad de Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: O quartê intrego o l’é reconosciuo comme patrimònio do mondo de l’UNESCO pe-o seu valô unico à livello de coltua e de stöia, e i prexi di immòbili en tra i ciù erti inte tutto o paise.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: E Çinque Tære comprendan i çinque paisetti de mâ de Rimazzô, Manaeua, Corniggia, Vernassa e Monterosso, che s’attreuvan inta region italiaña da Liguria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: En conscideræ da l’UNESCO patrimònio de l’umanitæ.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Into corso di secoli e gente gh’an edificou con cua de fasce in sciô paisaggio aspio e rapido, fin a-e scuggee che s’avansan in sciô mâ.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Unna parte da seu fascinaçion a l’é dæta da-a mancansa de sviluppo açiendale vixibile. I sentê, i treni e e barche mettan in connescion i paixi, e e machine no peuan intrâghe da l’esterno.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: E varietæ do franseise parlæ into Belgio e in Svissera an de legie differense da quello parlou in Fransa, ma sciben s’assumeggian tanto ch’abbasta da poei ëse intelligibile fra de liatre.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: In particolare, o scistema de numeraçion into Belgio de lengua franseise e in Svissera o l’à quarche picciña peculiaritæ in confronto co-o franseise parlou in Fransa, e a prononçia de çerte paròlle a l’é ascì un pö differente.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: À tutti i mòddi, tutti i belgi e i svisseri de lengua franseise an impreiso o franseise standard a-a scheua, e no avian di problemi à capîve ascì ben che deuviæ o scistema de numeraçion franseise standard.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Inte tante parte do mondo mesciâ a man o l’é un gesto d’amixiçia ch’o l’indica o saluo.
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: In cangio in Malesia, a-o manco inte zöne de campagne, o scignifica ‘vegnî da niatri’, un pö comme o dio ch’o segna cegou verso o còrpo de chi parla, un gesto deuviou inte çerti paixi de l’oçidente e ch’o doviæ vegnî deuviou solo con quello fin.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Do mæximo, un viægiatô britannico in Spagna o porrieiva confonde un saluo co-o creuso da man giou verso chi salua (ciufito che verso a persoña ch’a ven saluâ) comme un gesto inteiso pe ciammâlo inderê.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: E lengue auxiliäie en lengue artifiçiæ ò pianificæ, creæ co-o fin de façilitâ a conversaçion tra de gente che sedonca avieivan de difficoltæ into communicâ.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: En despæge da-e lengue franche, che son lengue naturale ò organiche che razzonzan un ròllo dominante, pe unna raxon ò pe l’atra, comme mezzo de communicaçion tra parlanti de lengue differente.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Into cado do giorno i viægiatoî peuan avei di miraggi che ghe daggan l’illuxon de l’ægua (ò de atre cöse).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: O reisego o l’é che o viægiatô o pòsse anâ apreuvo a-o miraggio, straggiando energia preçiosa e l’ægua ch’a l’arresta.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Fiña o ciù affogou di deserti o peu vegnî estremente freido de neutte. Se no s’à apreuvo di vestî cadi, l’ipotermia o l’é un reisego serio.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Se deçiddei de fâ de escurscioin pe-a foresta tropicale besorrià che stagghi attenti a-e çinsae, mascime de stæ.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Fiña se sei apreuvo à guiddâ pe-a foresta pluviale subtropicale, pöchi segondi co-e pòrte averte pe intrâ inta vittua son assæ pe fâghe intrâ de çinsae ascì.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: L’influensa di öxelli, dita ciù formalmente influensa aviäia, a peu contaggiâ tanto i öxelli comme i mammiferi.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Fra i òmmi l’é stæto segnallou meno de çento caxi, ma çertidun an portou a-a mòrte.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Pe-a ciù parte en stæti ligæ à de gente che travaggian co-i pollastri, ma gh’é di reiseghi pe-i birdwatcher ascì.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Tipichi da Norvegia son i fiordi e e vallæ rapide, che tutt’assemme lascian o passo à un ätocian pöcassæ uniforme.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Questi äticen tante vòtte en ciammæ “vidde”, unna paròlla ch’a l’indica un spaçio averto sensa erboi, unna desteisa sensa confin.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: À Rogaland e Agder normalmente en ciammæ “hei”, unna paròlla ch’a l’indica unna brughea sensa erboi, de spesso coverta de brughi.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: I giassæ no en stabili, ma scoran longo a montagna. Sto fæto o pròvoca de creppatue, che peuan vegnî ascose da di ponti de neive.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: E miage e i teiti de barme de giassa peuan deruâ, e e creppe peuan serrâse.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: In scê ziñe di giassæ se destacca di enormi blòcchi de giassa, che cazzan e fòscia sätan ò s’arrigoelan ciù lontan da-a ziña.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: A stagion turistica de staçioin de colliña pe-o sòlita a razzonze o mascimo durante a stæ indiaña.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: À tutti i mòddi, an un atro tipo de bellessa e de fascinaçion durante l’inverno, quande tante staçioin de colliña reçeivan de boñe quantitæ de neive e dan a poscibilitæ de pratticâ de attivitæ comme o sci e o snowboard.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Solo che pöche compagnie aree propoñan ancon de tariffe da desmuo, con di rebasci pe-i viægi de l’urtimo segondo dovui a-a mòrte de quarchedun.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: E compagnie aeree che ê propoñan comprendan l’Air Canada, a Delta Air Lines, a Lufthansa pe-i xeui che partan da-i Stati Unii ò da-o Canadà, e a WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Inte tutti i caxi beseugna prenottâ direttamente con unna ciammâ telefònica a-a compagnia.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
